As the clouds of fear and sorrow lift from the sky of Jinzhou after the Battle of Norfall Barrens, talk of the long-awaited Riverside Games resurfaces. \nAmidst the joyous celebrations, with laughter and cheers ringing out, stands the general, seemingly alone in a sea of people. \nAnd perhaps, there is a story untold, hidden within his gaze...
Daybreak at Last

Solitary Path

Small Wooly, Big Adventures

Companion Story

Starlight streams through your fingers as you mount the expedition into the depths of the universe.\nThe gentle twinkles silently chant a song of gratitude, a tribute to the treasured gifts you once bestowed upon them.
Parade of Stars

Suspended in the sky, Avinoleum Theological Seminary has become a shattered reflection of a glorious bygone era in Ragunna.\nStep into this forsaken and forbidden land to search for the truth behind faith.
Winds of the Past

The streets of Septimont are teeming with life. Travelers from near and far have gathered in their finest for the Great Agon.\nExplore Septimont in this time of celebration, taste the bitterness of defeat and joy of triumph in the competition, and experience the glory of the arena amidst stunning landscapes.
The Everglorious Summit

On the crimson earth of the Sanguis Plateaus, the scorched front of Septimont's war against the Dark Tide, generations of Gladiators have carved their legends into the land with their blood. Now, it's time to walk their path, fight beside the heroes' spirits, and forge an immortal name in the fires of glory.
Hunt of Ash and Steel

The frostlands of Lahai-Roi beckon the curious. Many find their eyes fixed upon the endless white expanses. Truth seekers walk this polar region, one step at a time, chasing but echoes of truth in this land of snow where silence reigns. Now, join them in their exploration of the frostlands and go where no one has ever been before.
Unfrozen Traces

Beneath Lahai-Roi, the Solvein Heartwood towers overhead, as though holding up those long, shadowed ages. Innumerable motes drift here like traces of a past not yet extinguished, ancient and silent, waiting for an answer. Follow the light downward, and amid layers of dust, listen as those bygone days begin to wake.
Dimmr Traces

Lollo Campaign: Ice Savior

In the world of academia, time is everything! Researchers are waiting on pins and needles for data that never seems to arrive. Who will step up and lend a hand? It's time for you and Maji to shine once again!\nHelp Maji devise a stable pipeline for the efficient transport of research materials.
Lollo Campaign: Implementation
Uncle Fu says that he has a magical item.\nIt's said that this item is shaped like a scale and has a magical power called Chrono Trace that can make people relive moments from their past...
Traces of Mt. Firmament

KU-Cass, a merchant of the Black Shores, holds a piece of mysterious intel.\nScattered across the Black Shores are traces of ancient memories, and whoever finds them may reclaim the lost treasures of the Black Shores' founder...
Amidst the Stars
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.\nThe deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...
Traces of Tides

In the eyes of the Ragunnesi, Avinoleum Theological Seminary represents a lost era. Those glorious days have been forgotten with time. Perhaps one day, no one will remember the origins of that expanse of shadows hanging in the sky.\n\nAn elderly hermit is writing his memoirs by the seminary ruins. He needs some images of Avinoleum...
Acropolis Documentarian

KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvenirs in the Second Coming of Solaris!\n \n<color=#ffd12f>Complete Event Quest "Cube, Cubic n Cubie" for the best experience.</color>
Memory Travelogue

The clouds above bear witness to echoing battle cries, the wild lands remember the footsteps of warriors, and rushing currents carry the fiery passion of the brave. Here, every corner holds shining tributes to a glorious history. The towering cities, spires, and mighty walls forged by the people of the Septimont stand as enduring proof of their strength and resolve.\n\nAt the harbor, you meet a quarreling father and daughter. This unexpected encounter sets you on a journey to uncover the rich history of Septimont...
Uncovering Past Heroes

The Fabricatorium of the Deep has stirred beneath the waves, its unrest quietly noted by the nobles and the Order. To prevent further disruption to the lives of the people of Ragunna and to avoid unnecessary panic, both sides held a rare private meeting. In an unprecedented move, they reached a consensus: a full re-survey of the facility must be conducted to inform joint discussions on the fate of the Fabricatorium and the Common Echoes it holds. As the only one to return from that place unscathed, you are undoubtedly the best person to lead this expedition.
Deep Sea Survey

To Septimontians, the Sanguis Plateaus represents the very pinnacle of glory. Generations of Gladiators have stepped onto this crimson land with unwavering passion. Beneath the gaze of the colossal statues of the Heroes of Heroes, they fell enemies with blades swift and hearts ablaze, their blood painting the red forests. Countless legends were forged here, yet few know the shadows buried beneath its grandeur.\nAt an old lady's request, you track a fallen hero's spirit, retracing memories of a forgotten past...
Prints of Plateaus

Beneath the azure sky, amidst towering buildings and bustling streets, powdery snow swirls, while colorful koi streamers drift in the wind. People stroll through the city markets, unaware that they are but whispers of waves—fleeting illusions in a vanishing dream.\nA stranger arrives at the cafe and asks for your help to retrieve the memories hidden within the Irideglow...
Whispers of the Waves

Capturing Starlight
With Xuanfang's crisis at rest, an unfamiliar figure steps into Xianling Village... Bound to this land by a century-old past, he finally returns to homeland he has never known...
Shape of Yesterday

A new battle mechanic has been added when Resonators battle enemies: Off-Tune Mechanic.

Off-Tune and Mistune

Your Resonators' attacks build up enemies' Off-Tune Level. Once the enemy's Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.

During the enemy's Mistune state, your Resonators can unleash a powerful Tune Break, dealing additional damage. Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Within a period after being struck by Tune Break, the enemy's Off-Tune level cannot be built up again.

Tune Break

For powerful enemies, once their Off-Tune Level is full, Resonators must cast a Tune Break skill to deal Tune Break damage to enemies in the Mistune State.

Tune Break skills deal damage to enemies, reduce their Vibration Strength, interrupt their attack patterns, and reset their Off-Tune Level.

anh_en: It's been so long. I can barely recall their faces and their bravery against those monsters.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It's been a while, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: You've already forgotten? Well, maybe that's for the best. After all, fresh tales are always more exciting.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Anyway, thanks to that little adventure, the Order placed a nice bounty on me. So, going back to Ragunna won't be an option for a while.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Then I heard about this gladiating competition in Septimont. A stage where countless stories will be born! How could I resist?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Along the way, I've uncovered a few interesting things. Care to hear one?
Do share.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I heard a certain Laureate from Ragunna has become the Apex Duelist in Peaks of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: If something piques your interest, it must be something worth chasing. So... I gave it a shot.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It wasn't all smooth sailing. You probably heard as much from that gentleman Furius. But I managed to defeat the Lords of Prestige.
Congratulations.
You want to fight me?
What brings you to Septimont?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Haha, thank you, but save your congratulations. The story isn't over yet!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: That's right. I'm here to finish the tale... and I want to write the ending with you.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So now, {PlayerName}, I challenge you. Let's make this a duel worth singing about!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Ah, a good question indeed! Remember the little adventure we had in Ragunna? The one involving the Golden Anthem?
Of course. We're partners in crime.
Who's bounty is higher, yours or Brant's?
No, I don't remember.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Haha, I'd prefer to think of us as knights, like the ones in tales.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Captain Brant of the Fool's Troupe? I doubt anyone could outdo his price. I hear the entire Troupe relies on his bounty to survive.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Maybe I should ask him for tips on escaping prisons... sounds like a good way to make a fortune.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It's been a while, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It wasn't all smooth sailing. You probably heard as much from that gentleman Furius. But I managed to defeat the Lords of Prestige.
Congratulations.
You want to fight me?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Haha, thank you, but save your congratulations. The story isn't over yet!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: That's right. I'm here to finish the tale... and I want to write the ending with you.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So now, {PlayerName}, I challenge you. Let's make this a duel worth singing about!
What brings you to Septimont?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Nothing special. Just had a few... small disputes with the Order. Haha, anyway, I have to stay here to ride it out.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It doesn't involve anything particularly dangerous, but going back to Ragunna won't be an option for a while.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Then I heard about this gladiating competition in Septimont. A stage where countless stories will be born! How could I resist?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: And along the way, I've uncovered a few interesting things. Care to hear one?
Tell me.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I heard a certain Laureate from Ragunna has become the Apex Duelist in Peaks of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: If something piques your interest, it must be something worth chasing. So... I gave it a shot.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Congratulations, {PlayerName}. This victory is truly yours to claim.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Haha, looks like the legend of the very first Apex Duelist won't end with me.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: If you had bested me, you'd be on your way to becoming the next legend.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Haha, but no. That path isn't meant for me. I'm a wandering bard, remember?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I don't become the legend. I walk beside it, witness it, weave it into song, and most of all, tell its story.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: And the hero of this story is you, {PlayerName}, the Apex Duelist.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Look forward to the song I'll write, a song born from this duel, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Wait... so... you weren't just cheering for me because I always won...?

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: (Sobs uncontrollably)

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: No, no. Now's not the time to cry!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Congratulations, Challenger! Today, you've shown me the true face of brilliance.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Here's your reward, the second Medal of Prestige, the Splendent Medal.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: If you're aiming for the Apex Duelist title, the next Lord of Prestige usually hangs out by the Grand Lift of Janus.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Hehe, now that you've defeated me, you can't lose to anyone else, you understand? I'll be waiting for the good news of you beating the Conqueror of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Waaah! I lost! I gave it my all and still lost!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: C-can I still fix this? Maybe if I hadn't used that move... Yes, I should still have a fighting chance!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Challenger, t-that match doesn't count! One more time, pleeeeease?
An old saying from Huanglong goes, "No regrets once the move is made."
I refuse.

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Oh, don't cry, Liliania! You fought so hard! You're amazing no matter what!

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: Th-that's right... No matter if you win or lose, you're still our brightest star...

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hey! Have you found it? The recording of that duel.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Just a minute, Contender Lupa.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Hah, I was wondering when you'd show up, my fellow warrior!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Not even the Lords of Prestige stand against me!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I told you someday we'd meet in this arena, right? And now, that moment has come.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: This time, we're not teammates. We're opponents.
I'm looking forward to fighting you.
I'll give it my all.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Ha! Same here! Even if it's just a game, I won't hold back!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Come at me, Apex Duelist! Show me what you're made of! Let's duel, {PlayerName}!
Are you waiting for me?
What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: You could say that. Actually, I came to pick up a recording from Silver Helmet, the one of your duel against Furius.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Actually, I came to pick up a recording, the one of your duel against Furius.
My duel recording?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: That's right! I wanted to study your moves... figure out how to beat you. But now? Looks like I won't need it.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Remember what I said before the final? I've been playing Peaks of Prestige too.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: To me, it's just another kind of gladiating. And when it comes to gladiating... I don't lose.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: You really live up to the name. Well fought, my fellow warrior!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I don't think he'll be able to topple you, but still, be careful when you face him.
Got it.
I'll be careful.
Furius said he's an old acquaintance of mine.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: May victory smile upon you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Mm, it never hurts to keep an eye out. Good luck, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: An old acquaintance, huh? You've sure got a colorful circle, my fellow warrior! But once you're both on the battlefield, there's no holding back. After all, there'll be only one winner.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Anyway, good luck out there! I look forward to seeing you back at it again, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Heh, your strategies... they'd even work in real gladiating. I learned a lot today.
You're flattering me.
That's what the Apex Duelist is capable of.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: No need for modesty. After a hard-won victory, you should bask in the applause and cheers. Too much humility only dulls the shine of glory.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I bet this win added another brilliant mark to the honor you carry.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Oh, by the way, I heard there's another duelist who's earned the right to challenge the Apex Duelist. A mysterious one.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I don't know him, but I did catch a glimpse of him once.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Even from the outline of his admittedly broad back, you can tell he's someone who's used to gambling with his life.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: I heard from the other duelists that you've successfully defeated those three challengers.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: Well then, it's time to bring this challenge to a close.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: Show the full extent of your skills and strategy, and defend the glory of the Apex Duelist!

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I've been waiting for you, {PlayerName}.
...A professional to your bones.
(I bet he just thinks it's cool.)

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: More importantly, this place makes for the perfect stage for a duel with the Apex Duelist.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Take out your Terminal and let's see who walks away the victor.
Exactly what I was thinking.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Heh, this duel will be much more interesting than the last. Let's begin.
Long time no see, Calcharo.
You're the mysterious one Furius mentioned?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Looks like you're not surprised at all... Long time no see.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Mysterious one? I never hid my identity from him. Maybe he just enjoys adding dramatic flair.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you here for a mission or something? This spot overlooks the Ephor's Palace...

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: ...You might have misunderstood. I did come here on a mission, but it had nothing to do with the Ephor. And the job's already done.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Just a habit from the field. High ground's easier for scouting, and less chance of drawing attention.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: ...Let's stop it here, {PlayerName}. The victory is yours.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Still, being able to play it like a game, without those burdens... it's a refreshing experience.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Heh. Just some old memories surfacing. Thank you for listening, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Now then, congratulations on your final victory.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I must be going. May the darkness never reach your eyes, {PlayerName}.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Heh, this is the first time I've faced an opponent worthy of bringing my all to an Echo duel since I left the New Federation...
There's Peaks of Prestige in the New Federation?

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: No... The games there are not for pleasure. Losing there costs more than just your honor or reputation. It's about... paying a much heavier price.
I can imagine.
That sounds brutal.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: Indeed. Honestly, it's just a way for the stronger, more ruthless ones to eliminate the ones they despise.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: After founding the Ghost Hounds, I made sure to forbid such cruel displays.

speaker: Yangyang
anh_en: I feared if we followed that path, we'd lose our humanity, dragged into a darkness where there's no turning back.

speaker: NPC #850149
anh_en: Hi, fancy a thrilling match in Peaks of Prestige?

speaker: NPC #850149
anh_en: No problem. Let the duel begin, {PlayerName}.
Sure.
No, thank you.

speaker: NPC #850149
anh_en: That's okay. Tell me when you want to.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: You lost, so take your potions. No excuses.
Why Peaks of Prestige?
They won't just follow the treatment plans?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Hehe, after spending so much time fighting in the hunting grounds, their pride won't let them back down easily. In Septimont, strength settles everything.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: But you can't exactly brawl when you're laid up in bed, can you? So, I made a little rule when the game became popular. Any disputes? Settle it in Peaks of Prestige, not with fists.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Surprisingly, everyone agreed. Maybe because the game is just that fun?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: The only downside is... I'm bound by the same rule. Every time someone refuses my medical advice, I have to win them over with a duel.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: And today... I still have two stubborn patients left to deal with.
If I help you beat them...
You'll be free to duel me?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Technically, yes.

speaker: NPC #850009
anh_en: Can't argue back... I'm the loser, after all...

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Hehe, sounds like you're quite confident. Very well. I'll leave those two to you.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Just be quick and clean. Defeat them and make sure they follow their treatment plans, alright?

speaker: NPC #850009
anh_en: Ugh, drinking that bitter stuff is even more painful than getting hurt...
Excuse me, is the Lord of Prestige here?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: May applause greet you. Nice to meet you, I'm the Lord of Prestige here.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Judging by that look in your eyes, you're here for a duel, aren't you? Unfortunately... my hands are a little tied at the moment.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: As you can see, I'm the medic around here. A while back, the Gladiators launched a small-scale hunt for Tacet Discords, and now the camp is overflowing with the injured.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Many of them are... stubborn, to say the least. They only agree to treatment after I best them in a game of Peaks of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #250039
anh_en: Hmm... I see. Would you like me to be your sparring partner?

speaker: NPC #250039
anh_en: No problem at all. It'd be my honor. Now then, show me the true strength of the Apex Duelist!
Exactly.
No, thank you.

speaker: NPC #250039
anh_en: You've got things to attend to? Sure, by all means.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: Do you have time now? There's something important I need to discuss with you.

speaker: NPC #850245
anh_en: Let's talk in person... See you soon.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: You wish to duel me?

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: I'm honored to be your opponent.
Yes.
No, thank you.

speaker: NPC #850002
anh_en: It's okay. Just come to me when you feel like dueling. I'm always here.

speaker: NPC #850010
anh_en: I'd rather tough it out than drink one of Dr. Marcia's potions...

speaker: NPC #850033
anh_en: Ugh... my leg... my life is over anyway...

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: You're back. How did it go?
Two wins in a row.
All taken care of.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Right on time. I just finished mixing my last batch of potions. Now, I can give you the duel you came for.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Honestly... I never found Peaks of Prestige particularly fun.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: All for my patients. I practiced, followed guides, studied tactics... And before I knew it, they'd made me a Lord of Prestige.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Though you've done me a favor, don't expect me to go easy on you. My reputation is on the line.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: The third Lord of Prestige, Marcia the Lifespring, accepts your challenge.
But you still became a Lord of Prestige?

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Oh, I lost...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (If she and I ever got into a duel, I wonder if it would turn out like this...)

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: Well, at least I know you can take good care of yourself, even without my advice.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: As your reward... Here's the third Medal of Prestige, the Lifespring Medal.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: The next Lord of Prestige can usually be found near the Village of Respite.

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: May your journey be free of pain. Safe travels, Challenger.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (She's such a mature, gentle doctor...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (But... it feels like everyone's terrified of her potions.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Good for the body, sure. But the taste... Reminds me of a certain Fisalia friend...)

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I'm still eight hundred and eighty thousand short.
Fine... When do you clock out?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: That's not even counting penalties.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: You're here for a Peaks of Prestige duel, right? Hold on. Let me check the schedule my manager blessed me with.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Hold on. Let me check the schedule my manager blessed me with.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Swordsmanship training. Echo drills. Open matches...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Bodyguard duty. Event warm-ups. Pet sitting. Stage extra...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: According to this... I get off work in about four years.
Eh?
Is that a joke?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: For House Grandino, the only time Gladiators have is time spent fighting in matches... and time spent running errands for extra cash.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: If I can just make that much, then maybe...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Technically speaking, there's no such thing as "after work." Also, doing side jobs like this? Strictly forbidden.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: But if you can promise you won't rat me out... we can duel.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: See those three over there? My colleague, my manager, and the head of the House. Beat 'em in Peaks of Prestige, they'll be too busy thinking about new card strategies to notice me.
Wait.. they're all doing side gigs too?
Seems like it's better than what you're stuck doing...

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: In this job, there's only one rule if you want to survive: stay out of other people's business.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: So if you want to duel me, go duel them first.
Excuse me, is the Lord of Prestige here?

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Yeah. That'd be me.
I want to challenge you.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Not now. I'm still on the clock.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I'm a Gladiator for House Grandino. Being a Lord of Prestige is just a side gig.  I only squeeze it in after hours.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Otherwise, the House head would happily dock my pay for the entire year.
That's outrageous!

speaker: NPC #850014
anh_en: Gotta keep an eye out for slackers...

speaker: NPC #850014
anh_en: If I can report some of them, might snag myself an extra month's bonus.

speaker: NPC #850015
anh_en: Raul's workload is looking a bit light lately... better pile on some extra tasks.

speaker: NPC #850015
anh_en: It's for his "career development," after all.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Halt!
What exactly is this Peaks of Prestige?
No thanks. I don't want to become one of those grinders always on their Terminals.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Excellent question! As a die-hard fan, allow me to give you a rundown.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: No, no, please! I'm begging you! Maybe I got a little too excited seeing someone of your potential. I may have... gone a little too hard on the pitch.
Fine, fine. Just tell me what this game's about.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Right! So, Peaks of Prestige is a game inspired by Echo Gladiating.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Unlike traditional gladiating, you don't fight yourself but command an Echo Squad using Action Cards through your Terminal.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: No blood, no guts, just pure strategy and creativity. Every round's packed with surprises and possibility!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Bet you're a traveler, right? All you have to do is download the game on your Terminal, and you'll be ready to dive right in!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: We might not have a huge player base yet, but trust me! You won't regret trying it.
Any rewards?
So you're the one who put up all those ads?
Sounds interesting.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Of course! In Peaks of Prestige, you earn Prestige Points by battling others. You can use them to unlock stronger Echoes and power up your team.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Oh, just a heads-up: all Echoes you use in-game are separate from the ones you actually own.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: So even if you've got, say, two thousand Echoes stored in your Terminal... they won't help you here!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Haha, not that anyone has that many Echoes, right?

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Ads? You mean those suspicious leaflets saying "Come play Peaks of Prestige"?

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Nope, not me. No idea who made them either. We players believe that some hardcore fans just got too desperate to get new players, so they... went a bit too far.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Questionable method aside, it's working! We've got lots of new players, and you're here, aren't you? Guess it proves to be quite effective?

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Black hair, golden eyes, an outlander's clothing, and a Tacet Mark on your hand...

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Hooray! Let me send the game module to your Terminal real quick.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Eye contact, then we duel! Let's give it a shot!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: As they say, "Duelists are drawn to one another." That can only mean...

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: You! You're the perfect player for Peaks of Prestige!
Peaks of Prestige? What kind of name is that? I'm out.

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: Hey, don't be so hasty! Please, don't go!

speaker: NPC #850001
anh_en: I saw you wandering around. You're curious, aren't you? Come on, why not give it a try?

speaker: NPC #850016
anh_en: These new Gladiators... None of them respect the House's values.  It's all complaints and whining.

speaker: NPC #850016
anh_en: It never hurts for the youth to learn more, does it? And they need to stop obsessing over promotions and money. It's downright disgraceful.

speaker: NPC #850016
anh_en: Especially Raul. Better to crush that spirit early.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: You're back.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Before they spot us, let's wrap this up fast.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Maybe I can snag a few minutes to slack off afterward.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: The fourth Lord of Prestige, Raul the Dustbound, accepts your challenge.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Congrats.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Anyway. Here's your reward. The Dustbound Medal.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: The next Lord of Prestige is near <te href=850172>Cliffside Harbor</te>. Head there.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: As for me, I've gotta get back to work. Goodbye.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Work... is truly a heavy topic...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Feels like I've caught that same, exhausted aura from Zani sometimes, too...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe... this is how office workers fight in Peaks of Prestige...)

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Good news is, win or lose, I get paid the same either way.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Bad news is... I'm still eight hundred and seventy thousand short.
What does that number mean?
You were eight hundred eighty thousand short before. That's real progress!

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: It's the amount I need to finally quit this job.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: Compared to how much I want out, it's still way too slow.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: My goal is to save up one million Shell Credits. Then I can be free from House Grandino.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I've been grinding toward that for five years. No breaks. No complaints. Followed every order. Juggled four side jobs despite being under constant surveillance...

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Oh no... Where did my wife go...?

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: I haven't seen her since our last fight... I don't know how I'm supposed to live without her...
Hello, do you need help?

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Huh? You are...?

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Wait a second! Those are Peaks of Prestige modules on your Terminal! You're a duelist too!

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Perfect. You and I, duel! Right now!
Wait, what about your missing wife??

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Forget it! My decks are strong enough! Come at me!

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Oh well. Guess I'll continue the search for my wife...

speaker: NPC #50057
anh_en: Feilian Beringal, where are you... Last time, I blamed you for losing the match for your high cost... Now you refuse to fight for me...

speaker: NPC #50057

anh_en: I don't want to drink this.

anh_en: That's right! You promised, Master! If you lost, you'd teach me whatever I want today!

speaker: NPC #850003
anh_en: Please, teach me forging! Now!

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Fine, fine... After dueling a beast like that, I reckon today wasn't wasted.

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Challenger, the next Lord of Prestige awaits you on the other end of the city.

anh_en: Master, please, back to the forge—

anh_en: ABSOLUTELY NOT!!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Agrippa the Ironheart... Each Lord of Prestige seems to have their own unique title.)

anh_en: Masterful strategy! Flawless execution! The way you fought, like a hammer striking metal, fierce and unstoppable!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe I should come up with one for myself too, just in case.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I'll call myself—)
The Celestial
The Rover
The Almighty
The Quietus

anh_en: Putini, did you catch all that? Learned a thing or two?

anh_en: I think I understand, Master. Life is like a battle, right? You need to see the big picture, know when to strike and when to pull back... to forge your own fate!

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Wh-what?

anh_en: No, no, no! I meant you could stand to learn a thing or two from this fine challenger about playing Peaks of Prestige!
You should teach him something.

anh_en: The other leg feels numb now...

anh_en: Is anyone slacking off?

anh_en: There's still room for improvement...

anh_en: Someone's not working as hard as they should...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Time to rethink our strategy.

anh_en: These Echoes are just as useless as you Gladiators!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Eighty hundred and seven thousand short.

anh_en: Where's my wife...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Once again, I LOVE Peaks of Prestige, and I LOVE you guys!

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!

speaker: NPC #850032
anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!

speaker: NPC #850006
anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!

anh_en: Liliania! Liliania!
Is the Lord of Prestige here?

I'm here to challenge you.

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Hmm...

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: I'm so, so happy more and more people love me, but rules are rules, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Feiling Beringal...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I shall have my revenge!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'll defeat you...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...Peaks of Prestige...

anh_en: Wait for me! I wanna play Peaks of Prestige too!

anh_en: Peaks of Prestige is all about having fun!

anh_en: It's not fun anymore...

anh_en: Is it right?

anh_en: No, no...

anh_en: I won't play Peaks of Prestige anymore.

anh_en: Hey there, my fellow warrior!

anh_en: They say you've got an important match coming up tomorrow, right? I'll be there, cheering for you!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: You'll be the most dazzling one out there, of which I'm certain!

anh_en: Oh, by the way, I started playing it too! It's a whole different kind of gladiating, but it still gets my blood pumping!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Maybe one day, we'll meet in that arena too... Who knows?
Lupa!
What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Haha, I'm here for you.

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: I heard you've become quite a big star, huh? Even folks at Solis can't stop talking about you!
I'm just a casual player.
I'm just too good.

anh_en: Don't be so humble. I heard about Peaks of Prestige. From what they say, the effort you put in is no less than facing down contenders in the arena!

speaker: NPC #250009
anh_en: Hahaha, I love that confidence. That's exactly what makes us a team!

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Haha! I knew you had enormous potential the moment we fought. Looks like I've got a sharp eye after all!

speaker: NPC #850004

speaker: NPC #850004
anh_en: Slash through your foes like a red-hot blade! Hahahaha!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Let me show you the true point of Peaks of Prestige!

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Congratulations on reaching the final!

speaker: NPC #850005

speaker: NPC #850005

speaker: NPC #850005
anh_en: Show us your splendent skills once more, just like when you defeated me!

speaker: NPC #850008
anh_en: I can't wait to watch this showdown, Challenger.

speaker: NPC #850013

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: If you can defeat the Conqueror of Prestige, I think it'll only help me even more.

speaker: NPC #850013
anh_en: I'm rooting for you.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'm rooting for you.

speaker: NPC #850019
anh_en: In my life. "Finally." "Witnessed..."

speaker: NPC #850019
anh_en: If you win, we'll all be thrilled! Come on, you can do it!

speaker: NPC #850287
anh_en:
Greetings, Challenger {PlayerName}.


The stars of this moment are yours. Thank you for stepping into Colosseum Olymdos with courage and skill, and for keeping the flames of dueling alive.

I've been watching you since the moment you defeated your first opponent. Your strategy, your focus and passion, the way you honed each deck, it all reminds me of the pure love I once held for this game.

Challenger, fight with all your heart! On this battlefield, giving your all is the highest form of respect one duelist can offer another. No matter who will emerge victorious tomorrow, this arena belongs to both of us, two souls fighting for what they love.

May the dawn bring us a sky even broader than yesterday's.

—Conquerer of Prestige, a fellow duelist who loves this game as much as you do

anh_en: Oh? I see you've fought your way through everyone!

anh_en: They say it wasn't always like that. No, it was a crew of sailors chasing it down who left those three marks on its hide.

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: Can you imagine… what kind of men would have the strength to leave such scars on a creature like that?

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: Didn't think I'd find you out here in the Riccioli Islands, though. Came for a bit of a break?
I'm here to become a fishing expert.
Just here for a vacation.

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: This place is perfect for that, I'll give you that.

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: You must've run into my colleague, Clemont, then? He's been wandering the islands digging into the local history.

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: There are secrets buried here, ones even the ruins of Ragunna City have no record of. Secrets about the Sentinel and that Cetus the Tidebreaker…

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: Those lighthouses are the key to unlocking them, no doubt. Shame, though, the fishermen won't take us to the other two islands.

speaker: NPC #700098
anh_en: There's a legend... Say, ever seen Cetus the Tidebreaker? The creature has three gem-like holes on its back.

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: Fresh octopus clams! Just pulled from the water!

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: Care for a taste, hungry traveler?
Octopus clams?

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: Absolutely fresh! Look at this one's siphons, still glistening with seawater!

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: Just pop them open with a knife, squeeze on some lemon, and you're all set!
Eat them raw!?

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: Oh, they're delicious, you've got to try them!

speaker: NPC #700099
anh_en: If you're interested in buying, I've got the freshest stock around, no doubt about it.
Hello?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The old man stands dazed, staring at the sea as if he can't hear you.)

speaker: NPC #700100
anh_en: Pequod...
Hello?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: (The old man mumbles the ship's name again, but it seems continuing the conversation won't lead anywhere.)

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Are you curious about this old ship too? Hmm, seems like I'm not the only one who thinks there's something wrong with it.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: See, we've always fished close to shore, that's why we Riccioli fishermen use Gondolas when we head out.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: But word is, years ago Captain Ahab and his crew pulled out a wreck of a ship outta the sea, then left it with a strange fella to guard it.
That's not so strange, is it?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: You think that's it? Now, don't go getting all scared on me... This ship... it's a ghost ship!
Come again?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: There's a fella, Queequeg's his name, who's always mumbling something to the ship. And the damn wreck... it answers him! Mentions a "Flask" an awful lot...

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Eh, enough of this! I'm not saying a word more. Get going, quick!

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Otherwise, that crazy ol' bastard is gonna be back any minute, mark my words!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What in the world? How did this ship get fixed up all of a sudden?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: It's gotta be haunted! There's no other explanation!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Impossible. That's not possible! I've been keeping my eyes on it for days!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How could it get fixed so fast?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Strange... So strange!
Got something else to make a fuss about?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: My old man used to tell me that Queequeg had been working on this ship for years, fixin' it up with nary a single change!

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Now, all of a sudden, the mast is fixed and soon the canvas will be patched up too!
I helped him with the repairs!
That's all thanks to me.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Oh, it was you? Well, that's a bit odd, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: That fella's been at it for as long as anyone could remember, never seemed to age a day. The ship never got any better either... So what are you, some kind of magician?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What a great ship...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I heard it's called the "Pequod." Strange name, don't you think?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I heard it has something to do with Old Ahab...

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: This ship's huge, isn't it? But, something about it feels familiar.
Maybe that's what it was made for in the first place.
You can take Cetus the Tidebreaker off that trophy list.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Sure, but even though boarding the Fool's Sail isn't exactly something to celebrate... I'd still love to give it a try. Never been anywhere beyond the Stormy Sea myself...
It reminds me of the Fool's Sail...

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Yes! That's it, it looks like the Fool's Sails used by the Order!

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: I wonder what this ship looked like before. With all the new parts patched on, and its new shape, can it still be called the same ship?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Speaking of, do you know how to sail this thing?
It's too big, I don't think I could.
I know someone who could sail her out of here.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Imagine sailing a ship of this size... You'd look mighty impressive out there.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Abyssal sea serpents, hell, even a big ol' whale would be a walk in the park.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Ah, back already?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: I heard the news. The ship has ended up broken again, right?

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Ahab has disappeared, and even that Queequeg who's always fixing the ship is nowhere to be found.

speaker: NPC #700091
anh_en: Funny. Kind of miss him now...

speaker: NPC #700092
anh_en: Take that wretched pile of fish away! The mere sight of it flopping about makes my skin crawl!

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Eh, might be. Hard to say.

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Seems like we get a lotta pampered city folk wanderin' in here, thinkin' this is some kinda vacation spot.

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Look at ya. Can't lift a finger for nothin'. Never had to break a sweat or pull a fish out of the water, have ya?

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Tsk, bothersome city folk… Beggin' your pardon, miss, but do step aside, would ya?

speaker: NPC #700092
anh_en: You think this dress is cheap? The cost of cleaning it would buy every one of your... fish.

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Cheap? That fine mesh is perfect—for catching minnows. Scrap cloth, really.

speaker: NPC #700092
anh_en: Why, you—!

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Best you stay away from this place, missy. Don't wanna get fish guts all over your fancy dress. And who knows, a shark might just decide to take a bite on your way back.

speaker: NPC #700092
anh_en: Did you say... s-shark?

speaker: NPC #700093
anh_en: Big mouth like the doors to your Vault, teeth sharper than knives. One bite, and it could swallow four whole men...
Is that really true?

speaker: NPC #700143
anh_en: Hey, how's it going?

speaker: NPC #700144
anh_en: Same as usual. Only the small ones.

speaker: NPC #700143
anh_en: I don't know why, but the yield has been getting worse lately.

speaker: NPC #700143
anh_en: Tidebreaker...

speaker: NPC #700144
anh_en: Oh, great Tidebreaker, please offer me your blessings.

speaker: NPC #700144
anh_en: I'm not asking for riches, just enough fish to keep my wife and kids fed.

speaker: NPC #700143
anh_en: How about we try Serene Bay tomorrow? You know, leave some offerings there?

speaker: NPC #700144
anh_en: Don't! What if it gets angry and swallow us whole?

speaker: NPC #700144
anh_en: Well... we've gotta try, right? Maybe it'll hear our prayers if we're sincere enough...

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: Hehe...
What are you doing here?

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: I know, I know. Planck is everyone's friend. We can't fish without it.

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: For all these years, it's been a diligent helping hand. You don't see octopuses like that anymore.

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: Sigh... But, come to think of it, what do you reckon grilled Planck tastes like?

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: With those flexible tentacles, it must be really chewy.
That... That's too cruel!

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: Hey, I'm just joking! I'd never actually eat it.

speaker: NPC #700145
anh_en: I'm just... curious, that's all.

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: I'll need thirty Pricklecrab, thirty Bell-less Crabs, a crate of Legilimens Shrimp, and three Sunfish, alive. I'll go with you to the boat to pick them up.

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: They don't know how to enjoy a proper Tomato "Egg" Stir-fry... I'll make the most of it myself.

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: By the way, got any Stygian Phantom?

speaker: NPC #700095
anh_en: What? All I've got to eat are a few Fried Egg Jellyfish. Why would you want one of those? They're deadly, aren't they?

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: Don't ask. The lady of the house is expecting a special guest, and that's what they fancy.

speaker: NPC #700095
anh_en: I'll check with Old Hart. He's been fishing further out lately. He should have some.

speaker: NPC #700095
anh_en: You're talking about that Feshalia family, right? I've heard rumors they're a strange lot. Only eat poisonous things.

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: It's the Fisalia family. I'm just a cook, don't know much more. If someone dies eating one of thoseStygian Phantom-what-have-yous, it's not my problem!

speaker: NPC #700095
anh_en: So, you still want the Fried Egg Jellyfish then?

speaker: NPC #700094
anh_en: Yeah, toss me a few.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: The storm... It's gone?!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What happened...?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But they say only the Tidebreaker can lift that seal, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Huh? Where's Old Ahab and the others?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I guess we fish over there now...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Do you think there's treasure at Reyes Ruins?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: I heard Old Ahab talk about it once.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Something about secrets from The Order being hidden there. But he didn't seem to care.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Probably because he's not from Rinascita, right?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: How do you know that?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Listen to his accent—it doesn't sound local.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ugh, now that you've mentioned it, I kind of do want to check it out.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And now the storm's cleared, what better time than now?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I wouldn't recommend it though. I don't know why, but that place always gives me a bad feeling...

speaker: NPC #700096
anh_en: You're telling me... this lighthouse existed even before the founding of Ragunna?

speaker: NPC #700096
anh_en: Ah, it seems your hearing is a bit...

speaker: NPC #700096
anh_en: It's quite alright, old sir! Thank you! Have a nice day!

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: Aye, sure, you're welcome, kid. If you're serious about diggin' up stories, head on over to Helm Village. Those old codgers are no younger than me. They'll have stories to share.

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: Huh? What was that?

speaker: NPC #700096
anh_en: I said... this very lighthouse, it was here before Ragunna was even a thought, right?

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: Ah, yes, that's right.

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: They say Imperator built these lighthouses as part of some grand plan, something They laid out long before.

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: The tale has been passed down through the ages. My great-grandfather spoke of it, too.
That would make it older than the Order of the Deep.

speaker: NPC #700096
anh_en: Well, if it's really true, it would make this place an archaeological treasure trove.

speaker: NPC #700097
anh_en: Stove? You looking to roast some fish? Head to the market, you'll find it there, easy enough.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Don't let it get to you. We'll have the ship fixed and give it another try.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Not every venture at sea ends with a catch, after all…

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: But I'm out of coin. I can't keep going to the guild for help.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: The sails, the nets, even the Gondola—all of it costs.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why not ask Plank for some help?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You've got to find some way to make a living, one way or another.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why do they all hold Captain Ahab in such reverence? I've never even seen him sail before.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: You don't know? He's not from Rinascita. They say he was once the most renowned captain across the four seas.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I heard that when he scolded his crew, even the fiercest storms would part for him.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Is he really that fearsome? Then why does he still have so many people's respect?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, you don't earn your stripes as a captain by being soft with the crew.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: If Gulpuffs had less of a temper, they'd all be eaten into extinction by now.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What? Some people eat Gulpuffs?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: It's a metaphor, you fool! A metaphor!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The Gondola loaded with cargo seems to be saying, "Give me money and I'll give you goodies!"

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I say, it's been what... over ten days?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And his brain's still all scrambled eggs up there.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Didn't someone fetch a doctor from Ragunna City or something?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: And?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Well, if it was worth something, you think the man would still be in this state?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Right, could you tell me...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Why does that fish still look the same when it was fished up?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: And would you look at that weird glow in its eyes...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: There's got to be something wrong with it!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Hehe... Oh, my sweet...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Hehe... Hehehe...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Is he... under some kind of enchantment? I've read of symptoms like this in the Order's archives before.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: W-wait...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Ouch!? You... I'm...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Golden white... Jellyfish... Pitch black... A large fish... Huh? You're human... I'm a fish... No wait... My fish...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Ow, my head hurts... Who are you?
I think it worked!
Mind if I give him another smack?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: No one else knows. It's just between us.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Where the hell's my boat? And how did I get here... What?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: The fish... My, oh, my... From Serene Bay... The fish... Heeheehee...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: He's at it again! Here I go!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Oh? It's you.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Is your leg okay now?
You know this little guy?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I treated their broken leg from a Gondola accident back at the market.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Did... Mr. Coffin ask you to come here?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Wait for my return, my darling... fiancée...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I think they're trying to say that Mr. Starbuck's Gondola might know something. They're stranded on a reef nearby.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: And Mr. Starbuck has been like this for two weeks now...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: You want us to use these to free the Gondola?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Hmmm, I fear Mr. Starbuck might not withstand any more of the Order's disenchantment tricks anyway.
It does look rather painful.
It's for his own good.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: In that brief moment when Mr. Starbuck seemed to recover, he mentioned his Gondola and a place called Serene Bay.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Finding that boat and uncovering the cause behind his enchantment might be a good starting point.
Good idea.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Er, excuse me, sir? Are you the one who witnessed Cetus the Tidebreaker?
To the Gondola!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Heehee... Yes, we must have fireworks at our wedding ... "Sweetened fireworks"...

Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment. To help Starbuck come to his senses, you decide to locate his Gondola for clues.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Hmm? Yes, that's me! Are you here to witness our union? Marvelous! Come, according to tradition, a wedding witness must be present.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: A wedding witness? Well, the Codex does allow Acolytes to serve as witnesses during weddings.
What makes you want to marry a fish?!
He's certainly not acting like himself...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Over there!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Huh? Why is there a sweet scent in the air...？

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: The Gondola is drifting back!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A large dark gray fish flies onto your boat...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It does look similar to the fish Starbuck is holding. Maybe you can swap the fish in Starbuck's hands with this one.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: This means we need to think of a way to get that fish out of Mr. Starbuck's hands.
Then I propose...
It's time for a little switcheroo.
We catch one that looks similar and call it a day.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Would that work?
We're running low on options here.
They're all fish, aren't they?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Well, only one way to find out.

You and Phoebe find Starbuck's lost Gondola. Having theorized that Starbuck's enchantment has something to do with the fish he was holding, the two of you begin brainstorming a plan to get it off his hands.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The rescued Gondola appears to be shouting something.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: You came across a "siren"? A creature with a human body and a fishtail?
Could it be Lorelei?
Isn't she supposed to be in Nimbus Sanctum?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Could there be another being like Lorelei?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I suspect that the fish we saw earlier is connected to this "siren."

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: There's got to be a reason it stayed fresh after all these weeks.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Hehehe...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Mr. Starbuck? Captain Ahab asked us to come find you.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Old Ahab? Wait, what's going on here?
Do you know anything about this blue fish?
Do you remember what happened to Cetus the Tidebreaker?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: All I remember is being out at sea fishing not long ago.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: But all I could hear was a song, drawing me in. It felt like my whole body was being beckoned to follow that tune.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: The next thing I knew, I was drifting right out of Serene Bay, where the Tidebreaker is said to slumber.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: The singing was still there, like it was rising from the depths. I swear I caught a glimpse of the Cetus's shadow... then another shadow of a massive fish.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Oh, the curves of that shadow. A true beauty...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: I tossed everything I had into the sea, anything that could serve as bait, but still, it wouldn't bite.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Oh? My dear witness, have you seen my fiancée around?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Then, I felt a tug on the line as the singing grew louder... and everything went blank after that.
Did you catch this blue fish?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Yes! That's the one!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Wait, wait! Where is it...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Key! The key... Blast it, where'd that key go?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: The key... I used it as bait...
Whoa, whoa! You're not—

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Aha! I knew it! Molto bene! Got gobbled up by the fish!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Hehehe... You… What are you up to?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Old Ahab had me keep it. You'll be needing it too, yes?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A key covered in rust. Seems like it's seen better days...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: I can't recall much after that, but no doubt the Tidebreaker did make an appearance in Serene Bay.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: If you're looking for it, go take a look around the bay. Oh, and thanks for the help...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Are you...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: I'm forty-seven years old this year. After all these years at sea, I've caught more fish than you can imagine.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: But the right fish and the right person have yet to cross my path.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Oh, but this beautiful lady here—
Ahem.
We should get going, Phoebe.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Help! Somebody help!!!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Farewell, Mr. Starbuck.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I wish you the best! May Imper... May the sea bring you blessings!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Uh, right... Okay then...
Starbuck reaches inside the blue fish and pulls out a key…

You and Phoebe finally manage to grab the fish from Starbuck, and the First Mate's sanity is restored. Starbuck claims he once saw Cetus the Tidebreaker at a place called Serene Bay, with a large fish swimming alongside it. He hands you the lighthouse key Captain Ahab entrusted in his care before you departed.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Phoebe! Grab its tail!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I-It's so slippery! Disenchant!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Thieves! You filthy thieves!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Ugh... You... My head...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Who are you? What am I doing with this fish?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Let's light up the lighthouses on this island as Captain Ahab instructed.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: After that, we should go visit that Serene Bay Mr. Starbuck talked about.
The Tidebreaker knocks over your boat, and you're washed ashore by the heavy waves...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: {PlayerName}! Are you hurt?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: How about we take it to Planck? Maybe it knows what this is.
Still in one piece.
My fish...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: The Tidebreaker attacked us! Thank Imperator none of us were hurt.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Quick, let's check if anything was lost!
You check your belongings...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You find a bizarre fish, its color all wrong, and its eyes glow with an unsettling shimmer.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nothing's lost, except now we've got this...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: What a strange fish...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Phoebe!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Get out of the way!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: There are rocks in the way.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we can clear it with Echo skills!

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Once you reach the islands, go visit an old captain called Ahab. He'll be more than glad to show you the ropes.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: I've got to make my way back to the islands myself. There's a boat at the harbor that'll take you straight there. Just let the boatman know you're off for some fishing!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: I'm gettin' old... Starbuck... old...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Let it take out the Albatross... This time I'll...

speaker: NPC #100040

speaker: NPC #100040

anh_en: You see, Captain. What did I tell you?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: So it's asking us to fall in love with somethin'? That's just plain odd!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Bleh.

anh_en: O great, noble descendants of Reyes, hear my words! I offer ye me love!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Umm... I shall offer ye my love! The ceaseless waves shall be my pledge of loyalty to you for all eternity!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Bah, I'm gettin' too old for this! What dunderheaded idea is this, anyway!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Go on, {Male=laddie;Female=missy}. You give it a go!
Me?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Aye, you. Just a few words, for the love of the sea! What, need a pen and paper, do ye?
O great, noble descendants of Reyes...
I offer you my sincere—

anh_en: It says here, "Riccioli, shower Neptunia with your light. The usurper slumbers in the depths of Reyes. Offer your love to Reyes' descendants and the eternal life of the sea."

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: No, no, no! You're all doing it wrong!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: What do you take love for? Is this a joke to you?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Step aside!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: My love. You are the light of my life.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: No storm can keep us apart, for in your presence, the might of my love can withstand any tempest, for it is even stronger!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: My soul yearns to break free, for it has found its direction, yet I am tormented by my inability to reach you...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: It's working! It's working!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Oh, my dearest love—

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: What's all this nonsense?

As you find it impossible to pass through the storm looming over Reyes Islands, you head towards the nameless island Ahab mentioned. You attempt to dispel the storm following the inscription on the ancient steles, but to no avail. In the end, it's Starbuck's peculiar method of "offering his love" to the island that finally calms the storm.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Riccioli corresponds to Neptunia in Rinascitan astrology. In other words, the island is surrounded by the deepest waters in all of Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Ho, ho. You know your astrology well, Miss White Hat.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I'm just stating what everyone in Rinascita knows. It's also mentioned in the legends of the Sentinel Imperator.
What about the second half?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I... I'm not sure.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Offer your love...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Splendid! Now that we got rid of that storm, Planck can swim over here!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Some at the full of the flood. And I'm just a billow that kisses the storm.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Go, Captain. Do what you must and whatever your heart desires.

speaker: NPC #100040

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: You did well back there, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Not everyone can survive the weight of the sea. She's a merciful mistress, but she can be merciless, too.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Even in dreams, I see meself hurlin' sharp harpoons into the water. They must sink deep before they strike with true power and precision.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Though we are blessed by the sea, we stand ready to point our harpoons at it... and at that fella.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Strife, chaos... endless conflict. This is the fate of those who live with the tides.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: How nice... Did you know? Some people die at the tide's ebb, some at low water...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Ugh. Hello...

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Oh, actually, I should thank you.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have gotten this far.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Well... Captain Ahab has his own ambitions. So do I.

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: *Sign* My beloved. Wait for me, will you?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: But then again, not too late is it, even now, to desist... Behold!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: Ahab, you old fool! It seeks you not! It is you, you, that madly seeks him!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: It says here that the key to the lighthouse among the ruins is sealed within the treasure of this island.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Perhaps it's over there?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Present the trinity gifts of the sea, and thus the light shall burn eternally.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: So this means... we need to find three "gifts" from the sea to break this seal?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Where the Reverberations converge. May they rest in peace.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The mysterious spirit seems to have enjoyed the fish and leaves feeling very much satisfied...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The mysterious spirit appears to have heard the callings of the sea and faded away...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The mysterious spirit gazes towards the last lighthouse, as if hoping it will shine once again...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: {PlayerName}, have you noticed that something doesn't feel right about Captain Ahab?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I can't say what it is for certain... But I just have a feeling that he's hiding something from us.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Why don't we split up the search?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: If there's a connection between this island and Tidebreaker, I'm sure we'll find something, especially with all the scattered ruins.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I can decipher these ancient Rinascitan texts. We'll have the truth soon enough.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: In legends

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: {PlayerName}, do you happen to speak the whale's language?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I'd like to sit down and have a nice chat with Tidebreaker once this is all over.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: But for now, let's make our way to find Captain Ahab.

After deciphering the ancient tablets, Phoebe believes the Tidebreaker is tasked to guide the lost souls to the realm beyond, and the "siren" invading these waters may be a creature similar in nature to Lorelei. With the information at hand, the two of you seek Captain Ahab's aid to deal with the "siren."

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Besides Cetus the Tidebreaker, I've also found information about the "siren" that might have enchanted Mr. Starbuck.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: It's a Remnant Creature that dwells in the depths of Riccioli. It may even be the same kind as Lorelei, who we met in the Nimbus Sanctum.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: With the Tidebreaker absent, the restless Reverberations of the departed likely accumulated in her body. Those lost souls were coaxing her to enchant the fishermen.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: She and the Tidebreaker share a symbiotic relationship. However, she is still weak, not quite as fully formed as Lorelei.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I believe she was the one mending Tidebreaker's wounds...
We need to get her back to normal.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Time to put our experience in the Nimbus Sanctum to good use. I'm certain we can make it work.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: It's just...

anh_en: Damn you, you cold-blooded beast I've struggled so much to conquer...

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: I've gone old, and the curse you laid upon me ends today... But I will fight you till the very end.

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: I'll run you down, come hell or high water!

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: O waves, unleash your fury upon me! Increase your might to the storm that carries me to my coming doom!

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: Men of Pequod! Our promised rest is nigh!

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: The whirlpools that once claimed my life, and the tempest that once filled my sails, I now call upon you! And that beast as well!

speaker: NPC #700124
anh_en: Come! Let us sever these bonds that bind us as we dive into the abyss to embrace our fate!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: We managed to get all four lighthouses lit again, {PlayerName}!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I've managed to decode inscriptions from a few stone tablets I found inside the ruins.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Cetus the Tidebreaker... is deeply connected to the Sentinel Imperator.
When the last lighthouse becomes operational once more, Cetus the Tidebreaker returns to its usual gentle self. Meanwhile, Phoebe has also made progress in her investigation of the island.

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: This ship doesn't seem to require a full crew to operate. A captain will suffice.

The anchor's up, sails are hoisted, Pequod sets sail towards the center of the sea, and the eye of the storm...

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: {PlayerName}! You have returned!

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: It seems you've grown a strong connection with it.

speaker: NPC #700103

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: To be honest, I haven't the slightest clue. By the way, where are you now?

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: Is that your Gondola that's sailing away into the waves?

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: Hello! Yoo-hoo!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I'm coming to see you, my love!

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: It's Starbuck!

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: The scoundrel's hightailing with the boat!

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: You there! Stop!
Ishmael?

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: The might of my love can withstand any tempest, for it is ever stronger!

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: That's... He's heading straight into the storm! After him! The man's lost it!
Where's Captain Ahab and the others?

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: I overheard that the Pequod was ready to sail, so I headed over to take a look.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: But by the time I arrived, the beach was empty, and I only found Planck over there.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Well, if it isn't my First Mate, {PlayerName}?
Brant?!

speaker: NPC #700103
anh_en: This is quite the ship you've got here. Looks like it's seen better days though.
I pieced that ship together, plank by plank!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Over there!

speaker: NPC #100053
anh_en: My love!

anh_en: Hahaha! Hold on tight!

anh_en: Fight till the end, Pequod!

speaker: NPC #1462
anh_en: Let us venture into the abyss!

speaker: NPC #1462

speaker: NPC #750088

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: {PlayerName}…

anh_en: We're safe now.

anh_en: It says don't beat yourself up over it.

To reel you in?

anh_en: Uhh, what's up, big fella? Cat got your tongue?

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Are they... laughing?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Whoa!!!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Of course it is! Look at it live and kicking. It's never been better.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: You were tricked and deceived during the Carnevale... I know that an Acolyte like me is in no position to represent the Order...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh, hey, big guy! Nice to see you again!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: But I still wish to offer you an apology, Cetus the Tidebreaker, even if it's only my own.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: You've been following its trail all this time, helping fishermen and receiving gifts of the sea yourself. It's trying to protect that stuff, too.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Oh! It also wants me to tell you great job on catching that big fish earlier!

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Just be yourself, whether it's giving or receiving, belief or hope, it says.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I see. Thank you for telling me that!

As the storm subsides, you meet the Tidebreaker again after it carried you back from the depths of the sea. Phoebe wishes to express her apology to the beast for what happened during the Carnevale, but the Tidebreaker holds no grudge. Maybe one day in the future, as a pro angler, you might be able to reel the big guy in...

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I still remember when you flipped over our boat last time, you know. But considering you just saved us, I'll call it even! Hmph... Like the old Jinzhou saying, something like "Big folks let little things slide!"
It's obviously way bigger than you are.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: The big guy says that "siren" helped care for its wounds, but then she went cuckoo after sucking in too many Reverberations.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: That's why it didn't want to fight her earlier. After teaching her a lesson, maybe she'll know better.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Tidebreaker. I... I have something to ask you!

speaker: NPC #1472
anh_en: Are you the one looking for a ride to Riccioli?
That's me. Let's go.

speaker: NPC #1472
anh_en: Take a seat, and we'll be on our way!
I have other matters to attend to. Maybe later.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Hmm...

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: I wonder if you've noticed, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: After you set the Tidebreaker and the sea right again, Captain Ahab, Mr. Starbuck, and Mr. Queequeg all disappeared...

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: I'm currently going over Captain Ahab's old journal, and it seems like they were searching for this "final harbor."

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Captain Ahab spent his whole life on the waves. He was the finest captain and fisherman this place ever saw.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: If we steer our course by Ahab's example, we might discover things, even treasures he left behind...
Can we catch Cetus the Tidebreaker?

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: It's a possibility. Captain Ahab always had an obsession with the Cetus, but why remains a mystery.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Well then, let's press on with this as our goal!

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: The sea feels ever so calm, and the whirlpools have finally settled.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: So set sail, Captain {PlayerName}! Your journey leads to the very edge of the world.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Everything's returned to how it once was… To be honest, {PlayerName}, Captain Ahab and his crew met their fate at sea decades ago.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Their love of the sea and their promise to Cetus the Tidebreaker is what kept their spirits lingering here.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: And now, the peaceful waters of Riccioli mark their final resting place. This is their "final harbor."

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: But the Rachel still sails on, and it seems to have taken a liking to you.

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: I believe that Captain Ahab also hoped you'd carry on his legacy...
What about you?

speaker: NPC #100047
anh_en: Me? I'm just a simple sailor and fisherman. I was born here, and I'll probably get married and have children here too. Eventually, I'll find my peace in these very waters.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ship getting better. Ahab lost his harpoon.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ahab says, once ship is repaired, we can all go home.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Ahab is captain. He is right.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Ship almost fixed up. Thank you. Only half to go.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Captain's orders. Almost working.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: As long ship is repaired, will be fine. All will be fine.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: By the way, that big "fish." Serene Bay.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: We failed before. You be careful.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Pequod is ready, Ahab.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: You can bring us all home, Ahab.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Go home. Home...

anh_en: The ship is fixed. Thank you. It is time.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Pequod, needs a captain.

anh_en: If Ahab not captain anymore, then... we still need a captain.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name

anh_en: The ship repairs look almost complete.
Rachel can't sail anymore. All has been lost to the sea...

You have lost your way on the high seas

speaker: NPC #1472
anh_en: Seeking out old Ahab, are you? He should be at the harbor over there.

speaker: NPC #1472
anh_en: He's no ordinary man, I tell you that. You'll spot him a mile away.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Zzz... Zzz...

anh_en: You must be that young'un Ishmael mentioned.

Yes, I'm here to try deep sea fishing.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Aye, good! You've come to the right place. The name's Ahab, and I've been tied to this harbor longer than most.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: That octopus merchant over there is Planck. It has all you need, from fishing gear to boat repairs.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: But... I see you don't have a boat. We can fix that! You can use mine!
A Gondola?

anh_en: The ones we use here for fishing are different from what you'll find in the city. We treat 'em like family—live and die together, we do.

anh_en: She's called Rachel. Gettin' on in years, but she's still got some fire in her.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Huh? Hmm... All right, cut it out...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Well, now that we've shared a bit of fishing, I'd say we've forged a bond, eh?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: What do you say we chase that big fella that gave us the slip? Let's head straight out to sea!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: I'd like to see what kind of fish dares to run away from old Ahab!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Oh! Ahoy! A fish! We have a bite!

anh_en: Well, don't just stand there, {Male=laddie;Female=missy}! Gimme a hand with this thing!

anh_en: Oh, wait! Easy does it...

anh_en: That's gotta be one hefty fish...

anh_en: A big fella like that? He won't be gettin' away from me, just a matter of time, no bother at all.

anh_en: Oh, that? Pah, that was nothing. Back in me youth, I could hunt a whale for a whole day, I could!
