anh_en: What's with all the ruckus over there?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: I overheard that someone from the Order's here.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: What? Are you certain? Are they here for the taxes?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: My grandfather's still hiding that ribbon he picked up from that Acolyte we drove away...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Have you heard the news?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: They say the Order's sending knights over soon!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: No way. These rumors are getting more ridiculous by the minute!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Look, isn't that just a wee girl? What knights...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Ahoy! That was some mighty fine sailing back there!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: You picked it up quickly. Good, good！

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Ah, don't forget to stop by the market when ye've got time to spare.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Minding the helm is only half the battle. You've got to know how to trade, too!

speaker: NPC #100048
anh_en: …Oi, the Order's got no authority here. Now, bugger off, will ya.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: That's enough of that!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: The Order's left us alone for years. If they really wanted to meddle in our affairs now, you think they'd just send one little girl?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: We owe our trade to the blessings of Cetus the Tidebreaker and these very seas. Ye're tellin' me we can't accept a wee lass in an Acolyte hat?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Right then, that's enough of that. Business has been hard as it is lately. Break it up, folks.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: If ye've got more complaints, toss 'em my way. Happy now? Off you go.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Thank you.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I'm here because I want to talk to the villagers about the Tidebreaker. No one has seen them since the Carnevale...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Friend of yours, {Male=laddie;Female=missy}?

speaker: NPC #100049
anh_en: Come on, Mr. Coffin. Didn't she just help you fix your Echo...
Yeah, we go way back.
We're acquainted, yes.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: All right, then. But know this—the Order's let these islands drift without a guide, so the folk around here aren't too keen on seeing someone wearin' that kind of hat wanderin' about.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: My hat? Err...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Anyway, just say ye're here on personal business and ye'll be fine. Now, I hear ye're lookin' for Cetus the Tidebreaker. Well, lucky you, 'cause so am I.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Yes! The Tidebreaker showed unnatural signs during the Carnevale not long ago. I think I sensed their pain and anger...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Well, sail around in these waters and ye're bound to run into it, sooner or later. But if you want the simple way... See that lighthouse down yonder?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: There are four of 'em across Riccioli Islands. As long as their lights are on, the Tidebreaker will answer our pleas as gently as ever.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Three of them went dark when the Tidebreaker vanished. Getting them lit again should do the trick.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: You know what? Why don't you take Miss White Hat here on a wee boat ride, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #100050
anh_en: Oh, pipe down, Coffin. The wee lassie was just asking you for some directions, for Imperator's sake.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: A boat ride?
We're going fishing!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: W-what? I've only ever read about Riccioli Islands' fishing trade in the Order's library before, but I've never actually fished on the sea...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: How do you expect the sea to answer yer calls if you don't embrace it yerself?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Oh, and hold onto yer "hat" during the ride. If anything else comes up, just come find me.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: What did he mean by that, {PlayerName}?
Just be yourself!

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I see...

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: Then I'll help however I can with catching fish while we locate the Tidebreaker!

speaker: NPC #100048
anh_en: Hell if I know what she's playin' at!
Phoebe?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Besides, do you really think she's helping you out for some devious reason? Being ungrateful isn't our way, is it?

speaker: NPC #100052
anh_en: But Ahab...

After you've recaptured the escaped fish, Ahab suggests you check out the market. To your surprise, Phoebe is there too. You find her in a sticky situation because of the locals' fraught history with the Order of the Deep. After You and Ahab help her out, Phoebe reveals she came here searching for Cetus the Tidebreaker. Ahab remarks that you'll run into the beast eventually just by going out fishing.

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I'm sorry…

speaker: NPC #1475
anh_en: I'm only looking for Cetus the Tidebreaker. They were injured in Ragunna…

speaker: NPC #100050
anh_en: Cetus the Tidebreaker, you say? Well…

speaker: NPC #100049
anh_en: Hey, look. Isn't that the Resonator who showed up in Ragunna a while back? The Laureate…

speaker: NPC #100052
anh_en: The Order is not welcome around these parts! Yer hear me?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: My leg... Where's my leg... Fetch me the harpoon...

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: ...First Mate... Oil... Where's my oil...?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Ahoy. How did it go? Pull in a pretty big haul, did ye?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: I'm gettin' closer to findin' the Tidebreaker meself. Just head over to the Helm Village and look for... What's his name again...?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Oh, right! Starbuck!

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: The man's lost a couple of his marbles these past few weeks. People say he only started actin' up after catchin' a glimpse of the Tidebreaker. Anyway, tell him I sent ye.

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: Also, notice that ship?

speaker: NPC #100040
anh_en: If you want to catch yourself a real prize, ye'll be needin' that one. She's still waitin' on repairs, but the watermen can fill ye in on that.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Now not enough.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: You bring material. Queequeg fix ship.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Ah, {PlayerName}? Ahab said of you.

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Bring me wood.
What?

speaker: NPC #100060
anh_en: Wood. To fix ship.

What's the difference between a coconut-flavored urchin and an urchin-flavored coconut? Nevertheless, one thing's for sure: both hurt like a charm when they hit your head.
Coconut Urchin

It is a common belief among the Riccioli fishers that the crystal cavities on Cetus the Tidebreaker were pierced by a crew of godless sailors, incurring divine wrath. Then, the fragments of the shattered crystals transformed into the Black Pearls—though Captain Ahab firmly dismisses this tale as fanciful nonsense.
Riccioli Black Pearl

A variant of the Gulpuff, often found near the Riccioli Islands. Unlike its docile cousin, the Bampuff is highly aggressive and is used to make "Sweet Puff."\nDuring the day, a threatened Bampuff will explode, dragging predators—or even fishing boats—into mutual destruction. At night, however, it can be fished like any ordinary catch.\nUpon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
Bampuff

A type of flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.\nUpon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
Coast Flax

A type of tree log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.\nUpon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
Palm Tree Log

Metal debris found in the Riccioli Islands territory. Despite being eroded by the sea, it's still usable as rough material.\nUpon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
Metal Debris
As is well known, octopuses don't naturally grow inside clams. These small octopuses actively seek out suitable clams, devour the original residents, and claim the shells as their new homes.
Octopus Clam

During their brief breeding season, Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells in search of mates. Fishers humorously call them "Bell-less Crabs" during this time. Their meat is said to become exceptionally flavorful, attracting food enthusiasts from Ragunna eager to savor this seasonal delicacy.
Bell-less Crab
Found across Solaris, this fish occupies a mid-tier position in the food chain. It is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide for short distances.
Airsailer
True to its name, this jellyfish resembles and tastes like a fried egg. It is one of the largest exports of the Riccioli Islands.
Fried Egg Jellyfish
Are they fish? Yes, yes, they are. Did I finish them? No, no...
Til the Fin-ish

At a distance, it resembles a drifting vegetable leaf, but up close, it brings to mind the legendary ancient dragon of Rinascita. Despite their grand dreams of becoming the mighty Pelagic Wyrm, their tiny size dooms their ambition to stay only a fantasy.
Leafy Seadragon

Most biologists in Rinascita agree that "Rainbow Eel" would better suit this creature than "Yarn Eel" based on their vibrant appearance. However, due to their timid nature, these eels are often found tangling with one another for survival. While "a cluster of timid Rainbow Eels" might be accurate, "Yarn Eel" is far less of a tongue-twister.
Yarn Eel

This octopus might not pack much nutritional value, but its charm is off the charts. With a cute appearance and a soft, graceful body that dances through the water, it has won the hearts of Ragunna's noble ladies, becoming a sought-after ornamental pet.
Dumbo Octopus

In the Riccioli Islands, misbehaving children are often warned about the Giant Gulper, a deep-sea predator said to snatch naughty kids at night. While this creature fuels many childhood nightmares for the islanders, the Sob Blobs, as its helpless prey, truly live in its shadow.
Giant Gulper

In the lightless depths of the sea, these clustered salps are a common meal for many deep-sea creatures—except Giant Gulpers. It seems these predators find the salps too small to bother with. To date, there have been no reported sightings of Giant Gulpers chowing down on salps.
Salp
It sobs for its insignificance in the vast ocean and its vulnerability to the gaping maw of its predators.
Sob Blob
The Pokey Moray once vowed to leave behind its slow-paced life—only for its ambition to be cut short the moment it ended up on your line.
Pokey Moray

Food, shelter, and fashion are no concerns for a Gooberstar. It spends its days lounging in carefree bliss, untouched by predators thanks to its unappetizing taste. Its life is nearly perfect—if only it could find a sponge to make things even better.
Gooberstar

Armed with a coat of sharp thorns, a Pricklecrab is a bold and aggressive predator of the deep sea. One fisher is said to have fended off a Tacet Discord by hurling a Pricklecrab at it. A creature of great ferocity indeed.
Pricklecrab

Known as the "Sea Angel," this delicate creature is as enchanting as a butterfly fairy. Many believe it serves as the envoy of Cetus the Tidebreaker, tasked with retrieving lost souls from the ocean's depths. Yet, given its diminutive size, one can't help but question its suitability for such a daunting mission.
Clione

These ancient sea flowers thrive in Solaris, fostering a harmonious bond with Seabed Snows. Their appearance resembles the decorative feathers often seen on performers' hats during the Carnevale, earning them the nickname "Star's Feather Crown."
Feather Star

The Stygian Phantom, a highly toxic jellyfish cherished by the Fisalia family, stands in stark contrast to Cetus the Tidebreaker. While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.
Stygian Phantom

Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.
Dead Man's Eye

During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.
Seabed Snow
If you ever venture into the depths of the Riccioli waters, beware of any glimmers in the darkness—no matter how enchanting their colors.
Trapper Anglerfish

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
Titanium Mackerel
A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.
Bubble Snail

Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"
Sunfish

This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.
Legilimens Shrimp

A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.
Lancetfish
Wait, is that... Astrite!? Holy crab!!
Astrite Crab

This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.
Tripod Fish

Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."
Rainbow Dolphinfish

As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.
Trombone Ammonoid

A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.
Reinfish

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.
Aureo Shark

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.
Pink Hallowfin

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.
Pelagic Wyrm

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. It is said that after Threnodian Leviathan was defeated by Sentinel Imperator, its subordinates were stripped of their power, left to barely survive in the depths. Draco Cobia, once a loyal servant of the Leviathan, has long lost the power granted by the Threnodian, yet it still remains a deadly predator to smaller sea creatures.
Draco Cobia

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.\n"In the Underworld palace, the archdemon sits on its throne, awaiting souls delivered by the ferryman. With a thousand grasping arms, it rises to seize the heart of the condemned. From that moment, the wretched soul is bound to serve the archdemon for a thousand years, a fate from which neither Cetus the Tidebreaker nor Imperator can deliver them."
Overlord Squid

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This creature is a top predator who has survived thousands of years in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands. Surviving the Lament might sound impressive, but facing its razor-sharp fangs is an even greater challenge.
Bogie Shrimp

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Darkness gradually dissolves as faint light shines over the crimson carpet. You find yourself standing in a corridor lined with an array of posters. This must be where the Somnoire Film Festival is being held.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: HI, YOU—! HELLO! Mind if we ask you something?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl is sound asleep. You get no response from her, no matter how much you try to greet her... Seems like you'll just have to come back some other time.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Without bothering her further, you decide to leave and explore the other areas of the venue.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The cinema sprawls out like a labyrinth, its identical layout and decor blurring any sense of direction. The corridors wind and stretch like a spider's web... After what feels like an eternity, you begin to piece it together. The maze encircles a central hall with five numbered theaters, all still closed off.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The central hall is a sharp contrast to the dim maze of corridors. It's bright, alive with a riot of posters, the scent of popcorn, and rows of souvenir stands. There, you spot a middle-aged man, his gaze fixed on the posters, studying their placement carefully.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: Ah, you two... I see now. Welcome to the Somnoire Film Festival. I'm the host, and the producer behind the films you'll soon be seeing. How may I address you, {Male=sir;Female=madam}?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm {PlayerName}, and this is Abby.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: Pleasure to meet you. The final touches on the festival are almost done. Please, make yourselves comfortable while we prepare. I'm confident our films will bring you an experience to remember.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm... {PlayerName}, where are we...?

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: There's still time before the event starts. Feel free to tour at your leisure. If you need anything, I'll be right here.
Can you tell me more about this Solaris Film Festival?
Can you introduce your crew to me?
What films will be shown?
Thanks, I'll have a look around.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: Gladly. With the recent rise in activity in the Somnoire, we've seen an influx of visitors from other layers. I'm honored to introduce you to the Solaris Film Festival, an event dedicated to showcasing films born from the dreams and frequencies of the Somnoire itself. Our crew's mission is to ensure each film is made with unique identities, tailored to give each viewer an unforgettable experience.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: Certainly. We are a crew of seven, each bearing different responsibilities. Preparations are nearly finished, and you'll likely meet my colleagues in the theaters shortly.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: We've categorized the films into five themes, each showcased in one of the five Theaters. Once the festival begins, simply head to the theater of your choice to experience the film.

speaker: NPC #800146
anh_en: You're welcome. Enjoy your time here.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: This place is amazing. What's our next stop, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: From what I can tell, we're at this Film Festival inside of the Somnoire. But why are you up, Abby?
Let's return to the central hall and speak with the producer again.
Let's keep exploring the corridors.
Let's head back to where we started.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You decide to head back to the central hall, your mind still full of questions for the producer.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A strange unease settles over you, and after turning a corner, you find yourself back where you started...  Sure enough, you spot a boy wearing a stiff expression glancing in the direction you just left.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hello there! How are you?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nice to meet you. I'm {PlayerName}, and you are...?

speaker: NPC #800147
anh_en: I-I'm a film editor. He relaxes once he sees you're not a threat.

speaker: NPC #800147
anh_en: ...I hope you'll enjoy our work.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Beats me. I was supposed to be asleep... Or wait, am I still dreaming right now?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: With that, the self-identified editor bolts away, not sparing a second glance.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A few twists and turns later, you find yourself back where you first entered the cinema.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The bench where the beret girl sat is now empty. You notice there's a handwritten note on it instead.

speaker: NPC #800148
anh_en: Go to Theater 1. The first film is about to start.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Following the note's instructions, you make your way to Theater 1. The closed door is now open. Under the soft glow of the screen, the rows of empty seats become clear.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wow, so this is what it looks like inside the theater! Finally, the show's about to start! I sure hope it's worth the wait. Quick, let's grab a seat, {PlayerName}! I wonder what kind of film it's gonna be.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What kind of film do you want it to be, Abby?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm... One where I'm the star, of course! Tag-teaming with you, side by side, we take out villains and share a gigantic feast for our victory!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Sounds like a Jinzhou Hero Play...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You and Abby settle into a comfortable spot, and before you know it, the first film starts.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Dreaming? Maybe.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: As you and Abby survey the area, you spot a girl with a bucket of popcorn resting on a nearby bench.
Say hello to her.
Walk around in the corridor.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hello?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The theater lights flicker on, and you slowly find yourself waking up.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: You're imagining things.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: But this is just the beginning. There are still four more films. I'm curious to see how you feel after them all, what you'll think or discover.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Discover?

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: That's right. As that famous saying goes, 'When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.'
Maybe I'm just here for the films.
Sounds like there are secrets buried here.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Which is how it should be. After all, once a film is made, it belongs to no one but the audience. Enjoy it at your own pace, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: You never know. After all, filmmakers always have their secrets... But really, it doesn't matter to the audience. Whatever you find, it's yours, and yours alone.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: I believe this is where we part ways. I look forward to seeing you in the next theater.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl in the beret leaves with a bucket of popcorn. There's still some time before the next film begins. What's next?
Share your thoughts on the film with Abby.
Head to the central hall.
Move on to the next theater.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, what did you think of the film?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby floats out of your Tacet Mark and slouches against the soft seat beside you.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Hmm, I think I had a pretty quality dream. Felt like I was back in Jinzhou. Boy, those dishes were so good, so... I'd say I liked it!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You can tell Abby really enjoyed the story.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Though, I feel like we didn't get much of a chance to shine... When do you get to star in one of these, {PlayerName}?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You are once again in the central hall. You notice two young girls chatting on the sofa. One of them lights up when she sees you.

speaker: NPC #800149
anh_en: Hi there! You must be the guest the producer mentioned! I'm part of the festival's crew, and a Stunt Double. Nice meeting you! You notice she's holding a drink that smells strongly of alcohol.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: At some point during the film, the girl in the beret had seated herself beside you. In the dim light, you catch the shimmer of tears on her face.

speaker: NPC #800150
anh_en: The other girl, a no-nonsense type with equipment slung over her shoulder, greets you in a more formal tone. "Pleasure to meet you. I'm the Makeup Designer. I handle the actors' costumes and makeup, as well as the stage setup. I hope you enjoy your time during the festival."

speaker: NPC #800149
anh_en: Oh, c'mon. Why so serious? Since you're here, a drink before the next film, guest? Good times never last, better enjoy it while you can. Drinks are on me! The first girl pulls out another suspicious can from behind the counter.
Accept her offer.
Decline the seemingly alcoholic beverage.

speaker: NPC #800149
anh_en: There you go! You're my kind of people. After work, it's all about good drinks, good films, and good company. Cheers, my friend! Enjoy it now before we grind again tomorrow!

speaker: NPC #800149
anh_en: Well, that's a shame. Don't you end up being like Makeup Designer over there, all uptight and no fun. She's always worried about drinking and accidentally messing up her equipment. I'm telling you, you gotta learn how to enjoy life.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It's almost time. You begin to make your way to Theater 2 and wait for the screening of the second film.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: What do you think of this film?
I already guessed how the story would unfold...
A classic, heroic tale. Not bad.
Were you crying?

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: I won't get mad if you think it's cheesy.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: If only every story could end like those hero movies, right? Where justice always wins?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The theater lights flicker on, and you slowly find yourself waking up.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: The secret to changing an ending is hidden in the script. If you want a different outcome, rewatch the films and try spotting the nitty‐gritty details.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: I believe this is where we part ways. See you in the next theater.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl in the beret leaves with a bucket of popcorn. There's still some time before the next film begins. What's next?
Share your thoughts on the film with Abby.
Head to the central hall.
Move on to the next theater.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, what did you think of the film?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby floats out of your Tacet Mark and slouches against the soft seat beside you.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Everything in that film felt so real. The mountain, the snow... Phew, I've still got the chills now. And boy, the chow back in that inn was something else! I should start keeping a food diary to keep track of all the good stuff I've tried.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You can tell Abby really enjoyed the story.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: ...What do you think of this film?

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: But seriously, what was up with that ending she mentioned? You can actually change the ending? Guess we'll have to pay attention the next time we rewatch a film!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: After returning to the central hall once more, you notice a serious-looking man talking with a soft-spoken girl.

speaker: NPC #800151
anh_en: Do you have any plans in mind after the festival is over?

speaker: NPC #800152
anh_en: I would like to leave this place. Visit other parts of the Somnoire... I never really planned to make films a lifelong career.

speaker: NPC #800151
anh_en: As the director of this crew, how can you say that? You should have more passion and respect for your work…

speaker: NPC #800152
anh_en: We've been in this field for how long now? Don't get me wrong, I do have a passion for film, it's just a pity that reality isn't always sunshine and roses like it is in the films.

speaker: NPC #800151
anh_en: I don't get your meaning... Isn't that why we're here in the Somnoire?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It's almost time. You begin to make your way to Theater 3 and wait for the screening of the next film.
The story felt strangely familiar.
What happens next in the story?
Were you crying?

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: I guess this is what they mean by, 'Films can triple a human's life.' There's this vast thing that connects us all, deeper than our subconscious. It's part of what makes 'films' possible in the Somnoire.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: As for the rest of the story, that's not part of this film. If you're curious, well, let's just hope the creators have a sequel planned.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: You have no idea how spicy this popcorn is... Besides, some people will cry whether they watch a masterpiece or a total flop.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Speaking of which, I have a tip for you... <color=red>Starting from Theater 2, all the film endings can be changed.</color>

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The theater lights flicker on, and you slowly find yourself waking up.

Move on to the next theater.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, what did you think of the film?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby floats out of your Tacet Mark and slouches against the soft seat beside you.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: I feel like I barely had any screen time this time... But hey, you finally got to be the star of the show, {PlayerName}. That was pretty cool. And I didn't expect that whole computer-thingy-hunting-you to turn out like that in the end!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You can tell Abby's pretty hyped about how that film ended.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: Wait, hold on... Are you actually a legendary super big deal like the movie made you out to be, {PlayerName}?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: After returning to the central hall once more, you notice a man holding a camera talking with a little boy.

speaker: NPC #800153
anh_en: Hey, you think that scene would've been better if we did a long take plus some jitter effects? Then we could also add some frame skipping and boost the exposure in post. Yeah, I think that's the way to go. I'll talk to the lighting lady and see if she can get us some smoke pellets to show when the protagonist enters their inner world. What do you think, bud?

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Didn't expect you to choose this ending… So, what's on your mind now? Care to share?

speaker: NPC #800147
anh_en: I think people have been doing that for a while now.

speaker: NPC #800153
anh_en: But if we use it to hide some story clues... Oh, someone's here.

speaker: NPC #800153
anh_en: Hello there! I'm part of the festival staff, and I'm also the Cameraman for our crew. This here is our Editor. Welcome! We hope you've been enjoying the films.

speaker: NPC #800147
anh_en: Welcome.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Hi, I heard you mention something about hiding clues in the story?

speaker: NPC #800153
anh_en: Haha. Oh, that...? We were just talking about some filmmaking techniques. In films, besides the general motion picture itself, a lot of information can be hidden in things like the composition, visual elements, and the way scenes are set up. Sometimes even special effects or filters can play a role in telling the story.

speaker: NPC #800153
anh_en: On top of all that, for films with branching storylines or multiple chapters, there are usually contrasts hidden in small details, story structure, or character setups. When you watch a film like that, figuring out which branch is the 'real' storyline and which one is the 'metaphor' puts you on the right track of understanding the bigger picture.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: It's almost time. You begin to make your way to Theater 4 and wait for the screening of the next film.
I'm actually more interested in what you're thinking...
There's no such thing as a perfect utopia.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: My thoughts? Well, honestly, this kind of debate has been around as long as humans have been making art. Even back in the days of witchcraft and superstition, people were already fantasizing about the bond between creator and creation. They always imagined that if a creator could just come up with the right thing, it would fix everything once and for all. But that's the problem, right? People refuse to face the fact that everything, and I mean everything, eventually falls apart.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Yeah, that's true in most cases, unless we're talking about the Somnoire. If you ever make your way to the other layers, you might just come across more scenes like that.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Well, we're about halfway through the festival. Have you found any stories or clues that caught your interest, {PlayerName}? Any guesses? If you have, carry those questions with you as you continue.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Till we meet next time. In Theater 4.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl in the beret leaves with a bucket of popcorn. There's still some time before the next film begins. What's next?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You slowly wake up as the lights in the theater gradually come on.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: The next film you're about to see sets itself apart from the others. I hope you're well prepared.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl leaves the theater after finishing her words. There's still some time before the next film begins. What's next?
Share your thoughts on the film with Abby.

Move on to the next theater.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Abby, what did you think of the film?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Abby does a long stretch while floating out of your Tacet Mark, and slouches against the soft, comfortable seat before sharing thoughts with you.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: It went down exactly the way I thought it would. Knew Fenrico was up to no-good right from the start!

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You can tell Abby was really immersed in all of its story.

speaker: NPC #1316
anh_en: But it sure looked like everyone in Rinascita was really having a good time. This alternate universe thing ain't so bad.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This time however, the girl in the beret didn't start off by asking you a question, but hands you her bucket of popcorn instead.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: There's no one in the central hall.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You begin to make your way to Theater 5 and wait for the screening of the final film.
(Have some popcorn.)
I'm not in for popcorn at the moment.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: That's some really hot popcorn. Is sweet popcorn not a thing anymore? This is the worst popcorn you've ever had.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The girl quietly withdraws her hand.

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: Only one more film to go.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Aren't you going to ask me my thoughts on the previous one?

speaker: NPC #200086
anh_en: After all the films you've gone through. Superhero, action adventure, sci-fi. I'm sure you managed to form your own understanding of these kinds of works. I'll let you enjoy the emotions from that drama film by yourself.

speaker: NPC #800361
anh_en: So the only explanation...

anh_en: Or she was just really into films when she was alive, and now she's dead and bored. Gotta fill the afterlife somehow.

speaker: NPC #800362
anh_en: But either way, newbie, don't think you can go poking around there hoping for a chat.

speaker: NPC #800361
anh_en: When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes back. Never get too close to legends.

speaker: NPC #800361
anh_en: And she watched THAT film again—"Leon the Unprofessional"!

anh_en: Is this some kind of rule-based creepypasta?

anh_en: A Ghost Miko... and films? What's the deal?

anh_en: You mean...
