You want to go see for yourself.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Yes. Even if it's just a legend, I want to try.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, let's meet in the club room after 11:00 tonight.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You catch wind of a "Film-Loving Ghost Miko" urban legend in the Academy's group chat. You decide to start investigating there.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, did you see anyone else on your way here?
No one.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: ...So she didn't come after all.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I actually got here early, just in case the timing in the legend wasn't exact. But I guess...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Forget it. Since we're here, we may as well watch this film.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, perfect timing! I met a Roya at the exchange meeting just now.
I'll give it a shot.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: He mentioned that a Soliskin guarded by their tribe seems to have made a mysterious friend. It's been coming home late, acting strangely.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: More importantly, once when a Roya Shepherd went to look for the Soliskin, he heard the sound of a bell.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: He followed the sound and found the Soliskin fast asleep in the grass. And no sound of the bell.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I think...
It's your Lady Miko, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Yes. When I was little, I went with my parents to make a wish to the Lady Miko. I heard the sound of a bell, too.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, would you go to Bjartr Woods in my place? For some reason, the Soliskin seem a little scared of me...
Leave it to me.

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chu, lulu, lulu? Lululu! (*Happy sounds*)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Are you inviting me to walk with you?

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Lulu, chu!

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chu, lulu, chuchu! Lulu! (*Excited sounds*)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (She knows Platya and I are tracking her. She knew I was coming today.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Tastes very nice. Thank you and your friend for the hospitality. Well then... bye-bye, little one.

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chu, lulu, chuchu! Lulu! (*Excited sounds*)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This cup of tea... is for me?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You watch as the Soliskin holds up a cup of tea. Though made from a tea bag, the aroma is remarkably fresh and fragrant.

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Lulu!
(Take the teacup)
(Taste it)

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chu, lulu.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Do you and your mysterious friend drink tea here? This cup... Your friend left it for me, didn't she?

speaker: NPC #100122
anh_en: Chu? Lulu, chu!

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, any new leads?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Thank you for today, {PlayerName}. Let's see if anything new turns up tomorrow.
(Tell her about the Soliskin.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I see. My father once mentioned that serving tea to guests is part of a miko's social etiquette.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: And... do you think she already knows we're looking for her? What if she's been close by this whole time?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: We just haven't noticed...
It's possible.
She could be tracking us some other way.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But if that's true, then finding her just got way harder. We haven't sensed a thing.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: True...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Still nothing... Ugh. No, no, I need to stay positive.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: ...You're right. I'll focus on my exchange work for the Black Shores and the Collective.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But I still have one small wish. If I can't meet the Lady Miko in person, I want to prepare a gift for her. Something to say thank you.
I know just the person to help you deliver it.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Hmm... but what kind of gift? I only know about the Lady Miko from stories. I don't know what she actually likes.
You could try asking other people's opinions?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Other people's?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Yes, like someone from your hometown. Or people here in Lahai-Roi connected to the Ghost Miko legend.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: That's true. More input means more ideas.
I know who to ask.
I have someone in mind.
What's wrong?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (Maybe I can ask Chisa. She stayed in Honami for a long time.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (She should know something about this miko.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Well, after we parted yesterday, I tried to pick up the Lady Miko's trail on my own, but didn't find much.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: And... do you think the Academy's noticed I've been looking into her? Suddenly my exchange schedule is packed with new activities.
Maybe now just isn't the right time.
Maybe the Lady Miko has her reasons.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: You... really think so?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Like you said, she spent her life protecting everyone in Honami. She wouldn't deliberately avoid someone she cared about without a reason.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Maybe for now... the timing just isn't right.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Hello, {PlayerName}. What is it you wanted to discuss?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Why the sudden interest?
It has to do with someone's wish.
It has to do with someone's secret.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: ...Oh, you're helping someone fulfill a wish again? Someone the Lady Miko protected? Is there anything I can do to help?
Not for now.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Alright. I don't know what you're planning, but I do have one small suggestion.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: When I was acting as the cafe manager, I learned something. Knowing what the customer likes is important.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: But conveying what you want them to feel? That's more important.
What you want them to feel...

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: If you need anything, call me. Anytime.
Any idea what kinds of things the miko of Honami likes?

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: The Lady Miko...? I didn't have much contact with her. As a child, I just followed my parents to make wishes.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: I was... scared of her back then. I always hid behind my mother's dress.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: But when we were trapped in Honami, I remember hearing some of the Left Behind talk about her.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: Back then, when someone came to make a wish, they'd bring her pastries. Different ones, every time.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: The Lady Miko rarely appeared on the streets, you see. The city changed too fast. Made her feel like a stranger.

speaker: NPC #50179
anh_en: So she experienced Honami through taste. The flavors changed with the times, and through them, she understood what Honami loved.
Pastries. Noted...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: You're back, {PlayerName}.
(Tell her about Chisa's information.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Pastries... that's a good idea. But I've never baked before. The taste or look of it might not turn out right...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Chisa also had some advice. She said what you want her to feel matters more than just what she likes.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: What I want to tell the Lady Miko...
Try putting everything you're thankful for into the gift.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I'll try. The exchange program's almost over, so...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: That's it for now, {PlayerName}. I need to hurry.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Alright, my schedule for the day is cleared. Now I just...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Yeah. Of course.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But you didn't come all this way just to say that, did you?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Ahem, no. This is a little embarrassing, heh... I actually have a personal favor to ask.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I'm here for the Black Shores–Spacetrek Collective exchange program. But I'm also here for personal reasons.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: You've been living at Startorch for a while now, so I thought you could help. But if it's inconvenient, just say so! Really, it's okay!
It's no trouble.
Tell me about it first.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What, do I look like the type to mope around and make everyone fuss over me? Go on. I want to help if I can.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Mm!

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: It's about a miko from my hometown. I don't know if you've heard, but Ashinohara's defense against the Threnodian was built around mikos.
Long time no see, Platya.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Among them, there was one who was special. She bore the title "Flaming Sakura," but to us, she was just the "Lady Miko."

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: When I was a child, I caught a glimpse of her once. Just her back.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: She was gazing at a giant tree covered in wish slips. The wind blew her long sleeves like a kite with a broken string.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Then she turned. Did she see me? I don't know. Maybe it was the distance. Maybe it's just my memory. But... I can't remember her face anymore.
What happened after that?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Later... Honami fell. While I tried to escape, I encountered a swarm of Tacet Discords. And all I could think was—I don't want to die.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: That's when I saw her again. That same silhouette. She only said one thing to me: "Run. Live."

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Even at the very end, the Lady Miko was doing everything she could to protect us.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Since then, there hasn't been any news of her. Not until recently, when I heard from another Bloom Bearer about a legend of a "Ghost Miko" in Lahai-Roi.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: The descriptions match the "Lady Miko." So I figured, since I'm here for the exchange, I'd try to find out more.
Here to experience Academy life too?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: If the Ghost Miko really is her, I want to find and thank her in person.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Actually... during a recent incident at the Academy, I met a miko. She helped me out, then disappeared.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (And Hiyuki mentioned in her last message that she's been searching for traces of Aemeath. But she did ask me to keep that quiet for now.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I don't know if she's the Lady Miko you're talking about.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Really?! So she's not a ghost after all! There really is a miko in this Academy! {PlayerName}, you know this place well. Can you help me investigate?
What do you need from me?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I've actually gathered some clues already. Done a little prep work.  But give me a little time to organize everything.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Once I've gone through it all, we can discuss our next move.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, it's been a while! After the others at the Black Shores learned you were going to Startorch Academy, everyone's been worried about how you're settling in.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: The things you've been dealing with... we've learned bits and pieces from the Collective's briefings.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: You haven't formally requested assistance. That tells us you want to handle this yourself. And we trust you.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: After what happened to Aemeath... and with the threat of Aleph-1, I know now isn't the time to be putting everything on the line.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But I've made up my mind. I will bring her back. That's my burden, and I can't drag the Collective or the Black Shores into it.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: If you're sure that's what you want to do, then please, let us help. Okay?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: ...So tired. So, so tired...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Thank you. I guess... this is goodbye for now. After today's schedule wraps up, I'm heading back to the Black Shores.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I hope everything goes well for you at Startorch. Really.
Those are some serious dark circles.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Yeah, yeah... {PlayerName}, here. Please give this to the Lady Miko for me.
Did you stay up all night?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: ...Hehe. Yeah, I've never baked before, and my hand-eye coordination isn't great, so... it took quite a few tries to get it right

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But don't worry! I'm really proud of the final look and taste.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: And... from everything I've learned about her these past few days, I don't think she'd like anything too strong or overly sweet.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: So I asked an Academy mech to dig through the archives. Found this ingredient that tones down the sweetness. Makes it taste lighter, more balanced.
Leave its delivery to me then.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: This memory... is redundant. I'll erase that...

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Hah... You two might actually get along. Which is saying something. Hiyuki doesn't exactly do small talk.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Both of you have a "savior complex." As an educator, I'm here to tell you that isn't a good thing.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: At any rate, I'll make sure your friend's gift reaches her. And your request to activate the Exostrider... Fine. I'll see what I can do.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: I've already set a timeline with Hiyuki. This next trip is the last one the Collective is authorizing.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: That also means, until your own request is approved, you wait. Okay?
I understand.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Oh, and one correction. It's not just for "your own" sake. It's for "my student." And more so, for "everyone Aleph-1 ever hurt."

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: The Voidmatter in the Dimmr Plains beneath Lahai-Roi is growing increasingly unstable. We don't have much time... Go on. When I have news, I'll contact you.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: Oh? {PlayerName}. Here for some life advice? Come to chat with the President?
It's about that miko.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: She reached out to you, huh? I told her she shouldn't be going underground anymore. Seems she's acting on her own anyway.

speaker: NPC #150057
anh_en: You don't plan to misbehave too, do you?
(Hand Lucilla the gift from Platya.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: That's not why I'm here. The Exostrider is critical not just to the Collective, but to all of Lahai-Roi. I wouldn't act without authorization. Not for "my own" sake.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: This is a gift from someone the miko once protected. Handmade. Think you could pass it to her?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: And tell her I do want to save Aemeath. More than anything. But I don't want anyone else getting hurt for it either.

speaker: NPC #800359
anh_en:
Weather: Sunny
Log: All systems normal
I'm not good at writing these. But last month, when I didn't submit one... she seemed upset.
This should be enough to meet the word count. Everything's fine. Don't worry, I'll make sure everything stays fine.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: {PlayerName}? Is something the matter?
I have something I want to discuss with you.

speaker: NPC #701052
anh_en: I have something I want to discuss with you. Can't explain it quickly over text. I'll come find you.

speaker: NPC #701116
anh_en: I see. I'll wait for you near the Academy Plaza then.

speaker: NPC #800483
anh_en: Hi {PlayerName}, this is Platya. How have things been?

speaker: NPC #800483
anh_en: I've arrived at Startorch Academy. If you have time, let's meet up. I'll be waiting for you at the entrance of Rabelle College.

speaker: NPC #800483
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I've got the intel sorted. Is now a good time to meet?

speaker: NPC #800483
anh_en: Same place, near Rabelle College.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, there you are. So I've asked around, and it turns out the initial sightings of the Ghost Miko didn't happen on campus.
You mean I.R.I.S.?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Exactly! So you've already met her. I'll leave talking with I.R.I.S. to you, then.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I'll keep poking around campus. See what else I can dig up.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: They were in the Roya Frostlands. Quite a few researchers mentioned being saved by a figure dressed in plain white robes.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I'm convinced that the figure in the frostlands, this Ghost Miko, is the Lady Miko I'm looking for.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Some of them tried talking to her, you know? Shouting into the blizzard. But she never answered.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Only one researcher accidentally found an ID card where she'd fought a few Tacet Discords. Translated from the Lahai-Roi language, it read—"Special Response Force."

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: No name. No photo. Aside from that, the card was blank.
I've never heard of that force before.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But since it translates from the Lahai-Roi language, that proves the Ghost Miko has ties to the Spacetrek Collective.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I remember there's an AI in the Academy that can access Spacetrek Collective data. Maybe we can ask her?
You watch "Leon the Unprofessional" with Platya...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I think the students guessed wrong. The reason the Lady Miko keeps watching this movie... is because she sees herself in the hitman.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Back in Honami, and now here in Lahai-Roi, her life revolves around the duty to protect. And always at a distance.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: After all these days of investigating, I may not have seen her with my own eyes, but the blurry figure from my memories is slowly becoming clearer.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: It's late. Let's call it here for today.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Spacetrek Archive Retrieval AI, I.R.I.S. {PlayerName}, long time no see. What brings you to see me today?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Now, they technically still exist. But the system shows no new members have joined since.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: That's all the key information. Anything else I can help you with?
Is there information on the members?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: I'm sorry. The system contains no records regarding specific members.
Could there have been survivors from that operation?

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Answering hypotheticals isn't really my hobby, {PlayerName}. But if that's your guess... Gotta say, it is possible.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: If someone did survive, they never reported back. Or maybe the Collective never updated the data. Either way, the system still shows 100% casualties in that last operation.
Understood. Thank you.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Sure thing. You know where to find me if you have any more questions.
Search "Special Response Force."

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Searching... 13 results match your query.
Summarize key information from all results.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Affirmative! Executing operation. The "Special Response Force" was an emergency response team established by the Spacetrek Collective in the past.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Unlike Startorch Academy, they didn't care about research or philosophy. They only had one job.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Eliminate anything that threatened the Collective. Members operated in five-person squads, with year-round deployment in the most dangerous zones imaginable.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Over time, the casualty rate increased annually, reaching as high as 85%.

speaker: NPC #100204
anh_en: Then there was an incident. During one operation, all members of the Special Response Force were confirmed KIA.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: So? How'd it go? Did I.R.I.S. point you in the right direction?
(Relay the information  I.R.I.S. provided.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: So just the basics about the task force's history. No actual member records at all...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But... I think I.R.I.S. made a good point at the end. What if the Lady Miko survived, but the Collective's system never recorded her?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Or what if she made some kind of pact with the Collective? For instance... she didn't want anyone else to get hurt, so she decided the Special Response Force needed only her.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: After all, the Lady Miko I knew... was exactly that kind of person.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Thanks for your help today, {PlayerName}. Let's call it a day. Tomorrow we can brainstorm other angles to try.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I found something! Some researchers have encountered a mysterious miko during their expeditions. Which means... maybe the expedition camps have clues!

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I just sent you the coordinates for one of the camps. The others... Well, I can't keep bothering you forever. I'll check those out myself.
See you later then.
Try not to get lost.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Mhm! See you later. Hope we both find something good.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Don't worry about me. Navigating complex terrain is a mandatory course in the Black Shores' Bloom Bearer training.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: If you're ready, let's move out.

speaker: NPC #800360
anh_en:
Today, I walked through the valley of the shadow of death. I was surrounded by a swarm of Tacet Discords.
Right when I'd given up hope, I heard a noise. It wasn't the wind, but a crisp, rhythmic "ding... ding..." like a sharp blade tapping against ice.
I forced my eyes open. They were practically sealed shut with the frost.

A figure appeared before me. A girl, I think. White robes. She held a long, straight blade made of ice, transparent and clear. As she moved, the tip would occasionally graze the ground, making that cold "ding-ding" sound.
 She didn't say a word. Just walked toward the swarm. The snow swallowed her fast. I heard the "ding... ding..." of her blade against the ground a few more times before everything fell silent. When I looked again, both she and the Discords were gone.
 
I didn't think. I just ran. When I got back to camp, my colleagues  looked at me like they'd seen a ghost. Turns out I'd been missing for four hours. I told them everything. They said it was a hallucination.
So... was it?
Does a woman with a blade of ice truly walk the frostlands of Lahai-Roi?
Maybe I should go back there tomorrow and take another look.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: {PlayerName}, I'm done with my side of the investigation.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Let's meet up at our usual spot?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Hey, you made it. So here's what I found. Honestly, it's not much.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: When I was little, I looked up to her so much. But as I got older, I realized being a miko isn't all sunshine and roses... Anyway, not the point.
(Tell her the information you found.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I see... so one of the journals must've belonged to a researcher. He wrote about being saved by her.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: As for the other one... We can't know who wrote it, but what they wrote gave me a hint.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: It mentioned being required by "someone" to write the report. Didn't seem like they had restrictions on where they went, just that they needed to check in regularly.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I wonder... could the Lady Miko have the same kind of arrangement with the Spacetrek Collective?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: They have to know she exists. What if she made some kind of deal with them?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Which means, she's probably still in regular contact with someone here.
(Sounds exactly like the miko I met.)

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: What is it, {PlayerName}?

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: The places I checked were full of other people's information. It was too messy to pick out anything useful.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Nothing. I think your guess is right. I met her before while resolving one of the Academy's incidents.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I was curious about who she was back then, but the person I was with at the time said...
(Imitate Lucilla's tone.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: About that miko lady you're curious about...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: My lips are sealed on that, I'm afraid. A President has her principles, not to mention the Academy's safety protocol. But one day, you'll see her again.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Don't give me those puppy dog eyes. Even if you went and asked the President yourself, she wouldn't tell you.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: ...If you say so. But with all these coincidences lining up, there's no doubt in my mind that the Lady Miko is at the Academy.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: I'll figure out another way to track her down. Appreciate your help today, really.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But I did find one journal. The daily habits recorded in it match someone from Ashinohara. It's highly likely our Lady Miko wrote it herself.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: In it, she reminisced about one busy day in the past—what she ate for breakfast, lunch, dinner, as well as ceremonial dress etiquette...

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: She laid out her entire schedule for that day in detail. Didn't specify the date, though.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: But I think... that day must have been a commemorative festival in Honami. Only a miko like herself would know those rituals that well.
Being a miko sounds exhausting.
Mikos must have a high status in Honami.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Of course. To us in Honami, the Lady Miko was like... the Blessed Maiden in Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Speaking of which, we've only been chasing footprints she left in the past. I know very little about her present.

speaker: NPC #750045
anh_en: Any ideas, {PlayerName}? How do we track down her current location?
Give me a second.
There might be clues in the student group chat.

Imagination knows no bounds. If left unchecked, such incidents will only increase. For Resonators, dealing with them isn't much of a challenge, but for ordinary folk, it's enough to spark panic across the city. \nFinding the one pulling the strings should be our priority...

Maybe because you went to Avinoleum and uncovered some of the truths the Order is desperate to hide... \nIt will take a lot more than that to even leave a scratch on you. Perhaps they're having someone else do their dirty work. \nThat just makes finding the one pulling the strings a top priority...

Banished and forever stripped of the right to sing for the Sentinel and the Order... that much is true. \nThe Order's records say as much. But there's still... something missing. \nIf such an important melody is lost, we won't be able to find the link between the poets and the Order...

On the surface, yes, the Order certainly upheld Ragunna's prosperity and stability…\nThe poets, praised for their songs to honor the Sentinel, earned the Order's favor. Despite their banishment, their works still serve the Order's cause today.\nBut this, my friend, doesn't strike the right chord we need to follow...
Simply knowing the Order once stood with the poets doesn't reveal the true reason behind their banishment.
A fire seemingly forged from the depths of hell destroyed everything, leaving nothing but ash behind. \nAnd so... their work, too, was swallowed in the flames?

That doesn't quite add up. \nIf hellfire was all that remained from the Pilgrim's Sail, then... could they really have been trying to curse Ragunna?\nIf that were the case... well, shouldn't the curse have come true?

That's an awfully big assumption! What if they never boarded the Pilgrim's Sail at all? What if none of them perished in that fire? \nThat begs the question, who was on that ship? Who started the fire and spread the rumors about the Golden Anthem?
It must be another poet!

Another poet intimately familiar with the poets of the Golden Anthem, you say? \nIf such a person exists, then why haven't the Golden Anthem stepped forward to prove their innocence?\nNo... That's not it. This will take the story in the wrong direction...
Compared to the Order, we were just a tiny speck of dust. Even if we'd kept the secret, they would've discovered it eventually. \nThey would seize what the poets left behind and lock it away.

Maybe, if Father hadn't taken in the poets' legacy, the Toccata family would've escaped this fate.\nPerhaps none of this would've happened... \nIf so, wouldn't it have been wiser to surrender it all to the Order back then?
No, you know that's not true...
The fate of the Toccata family might've taken a different turn. \nBut when you face the Order of the Deep and their false Divinity... our fate is no longer ours to control.
Is that what you think? Well, that's one way to look at it.\nBut it wasn't ever the poets' intent to curse Rinascita.

No, it was the Order and others who "cursed" their works, then deliberately spread them as "forbidden works" to the public... \nBut why? If their aim was to silence you for knowing the truth about the Blessed Maiden and Imperator, it was a clumsy attempt.
Maybe they have other motives.

Monsters breed fear, and perhaps fear is exactly what the Order of the Deep and this puppet master want to see.\nIt seems we've become pawns in Fenrico and this puppet master's game...\nThe more I think about it... we, too, have become the very ones to curse Rinascita...

Our crime was the same as the poets. "Blasphemy." \nOur family wasn't like the Fisalias, deeply rooted in tradition, nor were we like the Montellis, wielding power. We simply did what we thought was right, preserving everything for those who would come after us.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: ...A harp. It's in excellent condition, but its tone is flat and dull. Let's keep it for now and see if there are any other instruments nearby.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: A flute... but it sounds sharp and harsh. If this were a performance...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I'd say it's trying to finish as quickly as possible, barely giving the notes a chance to breathe.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Is that a lute...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Its echoes are faint. Perhaps because it's been abandoned longer than the previous two. I'll need some time to decipher it.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Wait, the sound may be weak, but there's an undeniable strength to it...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: {PlayerName}, behind you!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It seems this lute likely belonged to a member of the Poets Society.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Which is to say, it holds the melodies they left behind...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The timbre also matches... I believe this lute is exactly what we've been looking for.
You discover the instruments of the Poets Society, and Ciaccona decides to use it to recreate the past.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Sometimes, even when the instruments are the same, the performer's mood can change the entire sound.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: For example, this lute doesn't seek to boast. It speaks softly, like a traveler sharing a story over tea in the warmth of an afternoon.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The true purpose of music is to express what words cannot.
It certainly has the style of a poet.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: {PlayerName}, if there's something you want to say but can't put into words, if you sing it, maybe I'll understand.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: But I haven't even heard you sing yet.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Me? Oh, perhaps another time. Once all this is settled, I'll perform for you. Be sure to listen closely then!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Now, it's in the lute's hands. I hope this melody holds a tale worth telling.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Listen, I hear something up ahead...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It seems like... an interrogation room. This melody carries the weight of the Poets Society interrogation. Let's keep moving.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Take care with each step, {PlayerName}. The melodies left by these instruments are extremely fragile. The realm we're about to enter will appear fragmented.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: Faroll of the Golden Anthem. Know that Imperator is stern, yet merciful.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: As long as you repent and help us destroy those blasphemous poems and songs, the Sentinel shall show mercy.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: You are a wise man. I trust you will make the right choice. I look forward to seeing you tomorrow. Good night, Mr. Faroll.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: I will always be here should you wish to receive the Sentinel's mercy.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: No need to worry, Sir Acolyte. In fact, I'm beginning to enjoy the cold.

In the Realm of Melodies, you witness the Poets Society facing interrogation by the Order. Despite the pressure, Faroll, a member of the Society, does not resist, but calmly accepts whatever comes his way.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: The Codex teaches us, "Those whose sins are cleansed by the sea shall remain blessed by the sea."

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: It is a grave offense to slander the Sentinel. This includes your claim that "the Sentinel's true form is a steed of the skies."

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: I was told you found this lie carved on a lithograph. "In the face of the tempest, a giant Celestial Steed carved a path for the ark." How absurd.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: If you admit you were mistaken at tomorrow's trial and reveal where you have hidden the evidence, I will move mountains to protect you and your companions.

speaker: NPC #200036
anh_en: Remember, Imperator only responds to repentance, not silence.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: I'm sorry, Sir Acolyte. I'm doing my best to cooperate. Please don't mistake my silence for defiance. It's just... this room is freezing, and I've caught a chill. Makes it hard to talk.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: I'm afraid that by the time I see the Sentinel, I will have lost my voice entirely. Perhaps then, They will judge you for silencing a poor transgressor's confession.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Where is this place? A study? Ciaccona are we... Ciaccona?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: We must have gotten separated. Ciaccona did say even a slight misstep could draw us into other melodies. Am I...

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: ..."You are to build a home here, like seabirds. Dwell upon the water, just as countless stars dot the night sky."

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: I don't know if what I'm feeling is right or wrong...

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: {PlayerName}, fancy running into you here.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Their three members were once the Sentinel's cantors, but the Order banished them for insulting the Divinity.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Allegedly, their Pilgrim's Sail caught fire and none on board survived, and thus their last known work disappeared.

speaker: NPC #200054
anh_en: Well, since the manuscript is no longer a secret, how does the tune sound?

speaker: NPC #200033
anh_en: Give me a second, let me think...

speaker: NPC #200033
anh_en: Ah! Hear that? It's exactly what they're playing now!
What just happened?!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Well... it would appear they were possessed by Daemons, just as this very article suggests.

At the Margherita's Restaurant, you meet Carlotta. While sharing a meal, you overhear a rumor about the "Golden Anthem." \nIt's said that playing their last works can summon the Daemons. Suddenly, the melody begins to play, and the so-called Daemons quietly appear behind you.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Won't you dine with me? Ms. Margherita asked me to sample her newest pizza, but my goodness, these portions...

speaker: NPC #200033
anh_en: Did you hear what the Order's Acolytes found while clearing the abandoned library? A manuscript of a poem with an accompanying music sheet.

speaker: NPC #200033
anh_en: The public has already caught wind of its contents. Did you know it was signed as Golden Anthem?

speaker: NPC #200033
anh_en: They say it was their last work, written aboard the Pilgrim's Sail. I reckon the original finder fished it out of the sea and put it in the library, not knowing what it was.

speaker: NPC #200054
anh_en: Shhh... quiet. They're criminals. Best not to mention them in public.
Golden Anthem?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Shh, that name is not to be spoken of in Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Simply put, the Golden Anthem was once a renowned Poets Society.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: They were clearly the Sentinel's cantors. Why would anyone call them criminals who insulted Divinity?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: {PlayerName}, {PlayerName}! Are you alright?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: As I said before... for family matters, let the past stay where it belongs.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Just call me Ciaccona! We don't need to overcomplicate things.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Really, I ended up nowhere in particular.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Hm. Well, we have made some progress. The melody we were in gave me a hint on what to do next.
Next stop is the Order, right?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Yes. Seeing as they banished the Golden Anthem, we might find more clues in the Cathedral of Mercury.
Ugh...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Finally, I got you out of there! You must've been drawn into a different melody on our way out.
(Recount what you saw in the study)
(Don't tell Ciaccona what you saw.)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I just walked into a study and ran into a strange little girl. She seemed quite taken with the Poets Society's work.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: She mentioned a name—Ciaccona Toccata

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I see...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I don't know who you met, but Toccata is my family name.

speaker: NPC #200065
anh_en: Have you found her yet?

speaker: NPC #200065
anh_en: Raisa is our lead chorister. We took a break from rehearsing to play hide and seek, but when the time ran out, we couldn't find her.

speaker: NPC #200024
anh_en: Maybe she got mad at us because we sang badly... She hasn't smiled at us much since rehearsals started.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Can you tell your big sister here what hymn you're rehearsing？

speaker: NPC #200041
anh_en: The teacher says it's a hymn to honor the brave knights and the Sentinel's guidance.

speaker: NPC #200041
anh_en: But Raisa says the hymn was written by a bunch of criminals.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You and Ciaccona realize that these criminals are in fact members of the Golden Anthem.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Well... which way did Raisa go? We can help you look for her.

speaker: NPC #200065
anh_en: Really? She went that way!

speaker: NPC #200024
anh_en: No...

speaker: NPC #200041
anh_en: She's not here either... Greetings, {Male=Brother and Sister;Female=Sisters}!

speaker: NPC #200041
anh_en: Um, might-might I ask, have you seen someone dressed like us who likes to walk with her head down...?

speaker: NPC #200024
anh_en: No, no, Raisa doesn't like walking with her head down. She must've gotten into some trouble!
What are you all doing here?
Those are some very fine robes!

speaker: NPC #200065
anh_en: We are in the Order's choir. We're rehearsing hymns to sing at the ceremony.

speaker: NPC #200065
anh_en: Thank you for the compliment, {Male=Sir;Female=Madam}. These are our ceremonial robes. We're rehearsing hymns to sing at the ceremony.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Such a beautiful voice, isn't it?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: You know, our Laureate here definitely knows how to sing hymns.
Yes, I do!
Just tell me what's troubling you!

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: It's just... before the performance, the choir has to listen to the same music, recite the same lyrics, and do the same rehearsals every day.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: What's more, the hymn we're practicing... it was composed by bad people. Teacher calls them "heretic poets."

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Myron and the others never complain. They're always eager to sing praises to the Sentinel on stage.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: But now, their dreams are all dashed because of me. Myron, Patero, and Shia's voices are in perfect harmony. But I can never keep up.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: And I don't like this hymn. Myron and the others are too young to realize that heresy is a grave offense... But I know...

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: You... You're the Laureate! And-and you are...?

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: I-I just don't understand why the Order wants us to sing songs written by criminals.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: The more I thought about it, the more out of rhythm I became. In the end, I could barely sing at all.
But your singing just now was beautiful.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: That song just now? I... I've already forgotten how it's supposed to sound.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Well... what do you think a hymn should sound like?

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: A hymn... as the books state, is a song of praise for the Sentinel who leads the lost to the abundant lands...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: No, not that...  I mean, how does it make you feel? Try to remember what you were feeling when you were singing alone in the corner just now.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Oh... um... I didn't want to hold everyone back, and I really wanted to help everyone have a great performance at the ceremony.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Then hold onto that feeling. Let's rehearse again! You don't have anyone sitting in on your rehearsals, do you?

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Huh? No...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: My name is Ciaccona, a—

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Well then, the Laureate and I will be the first to hear you perform!
Along the way, you meet Raisa, who is becoming increasingly concerned about the Poets Society's past works. You and Ciaccona try to help her regain her confidence.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: —a friend of mine.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Don't be scared. We're only here so that you can finish your game of hide and seek.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Hide and seek... right. Myron and the others are waiting for me. Sorry, I’ve caused you trouble...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: How-how about a little chat first? Something's troubling you, I can tell.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: What? Of course not. The ceremony is coming up and the choir still has so much to rehearse. I-I'm fine...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Ah, young ones today have so much talent... If I had the chance, I'd love to learn how to sing hymns.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Oh, what splendid singing. Even the Laureate was enraptured!
The hymn's backstory.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Their assumptions were challenged, so they traveled to the knight's encampment at Whisperwind Haven to verify the truth for themselves.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Next time we venture into the Realm of Melodies, perhaps we should tie our hands together to stop you from getting lost.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: If the Order's choir is pointing us to Whisperwind Haven, then that's where we'll find more clues. Let's go.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The Poets Society was criticized for glorifying the knights over the common folk during one of their hymn performances.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: This incident may have been the turning point for the Poets Society. Did you find any other clues?
(Say nothing)
I strayed into a different melody again.

After returning from the Realm of Melodies, you share what you've learned with Ciaccona. You realize that the key to understanding the Poets Society's change of attitude might lie in their time in the Cathedral, a turning point that led them to seek the truth and resist the Order's deception.

speaker: NPC #200041
anh_en: Raisa did wonderfully!

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Thanks to you, I've figured it out.

speaker: NPC #200066
anh_en: Sincerity is what truly matters when we pray and sing praises to the Sentinel.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Yes, a hymn isn't just a few lines of history. It is shaped by your feelings and experiences.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: A hymn may differ in each person's eyes, but its resonance and meaning are universal.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I hope you'll give the audience a spectacular performance on the day of the ceremony.
Chorister Raisa leaves to rehearse with the other children. After she leaves, Ciaccona starts asking you questions about what you saw in the melody.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So... what did you see in Raisa's melody?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I've heard of these knights during my travels. This should be where their old encampment stood.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: But there don't seem to be any instruments, poems, or music here that carry the memory of a melody. Let's try searching the area first.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: These "Bonfire Poets" were no doubt members of the Poets Society. The note says they had wandered the area looking for inspiration.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: To find their melody, we should try to follow the route they once took.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Perhaps inspiration will strike us along the way!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: This was the last stop on their route. Oh, the view just now as we soared in the sky was just breathtaking!

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: Yet he spoke like a nobleman... But I can't afford to think about that now.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: If not for his help, we'd still be singing praises to a false Sentinel!

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: He's right. We cannot continue to sing for the Order anymore.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: We must enlighten the people of Ragunna. They deserve to know the truth.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: The knights of the Order defend only the Order's interests, and so... the time has come for us to become knights for the people of Ragunna.
What are you doing?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Playing a tune, of course. I want to capture the mood they must have felt when they were here... I'm curious as to what they left behind.

You find something that carries the melody—the wind. The wind is everlasting, recording and bringing back the Poets Society's melodies. Adopting the Poets Society's mindset, Ciaccona plays the melody once more, and the Society members' voices ring again.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: What is it? Has anything come to mind?
It's the wind.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Oh yes, how did I miss that. The wind is the finest recorder of melodies.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It rises from the primal, churning endlessly, echoing in our ears without end. I believe the melodies left by the Poets Society were witnessed by the wind, and it will carry them to us.
Ciaccona plays her instrument. The wind stirs, and the melody of the Poets Society fills the air.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: Rimbaud and Selena must have returned to Ragunna by now. That lithograph of the Sentinel's true form… it has to be here somewhere.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: Did that gentleman guide us intentionally? Who exactly was he...

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: Backpack stuffed with papers, claiming to be a common artist traveling in search of inspiration.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: We must confront his lies and put an end to these Daemon incidents...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: But once the truth of the Golden Anthem and Imperator is revealed, it will no longer be just a matter of Daemons... But... is now the right time?

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The will of the people is strong. This mastermind is so sure that the lies about the Sentinel will go undiscovered, and that no one will easily believe the truth.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: The truth exists to be uncovered. All we need is to plant the seeds of doubt in the people's hearts and let them take root and grow.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Yes... Let's get going then.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: We'll go back to Margherita's. It's where our story began... and it's where it must end.

The members hid a lithograph here. They were actually guided by a mysterious figure, but there's no time to investigate who they are now. What's most important is returning to the restaurant to change the public's view of the "Golden Anthem."

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Is this form of the Sentinel the same as the one you saw at Avinoleum, {PlayerName}?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: The majestic steed carved on the lithograph looks the same as the Sentinel you saw before.
Like twins.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So the poets were indeed banished for uncovering the Order's secrets.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Even under interrogation, they held their silence. It wasn't until they met this mysterious man and learned the truth that they chose to become "Knights of Ragunna."

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Resentment and curses are not songs of their own style. As for the true mastermind, we still have no direct proof linking him to the Order.
It's you again.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Then again, it's all conjecture. Those in the Poets Society died years ago, and who's to say what really happened?

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Now, if those vengeful spirits really do exist... well, out of all the patrons here, they went straight for you, {PlayerName}. Curious and curiouser...

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: By the way, it just so happens that I made a copy of the Poet Society's last work.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Goodbye friends, a change of venue is in order. I must finish my play.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Here, take it. Consider it a little souvenir from your... spirited encounter. Maybe it'll prove useful later.
Cristoforo approaches and greets you, mentioning a recent article from Ragunna that offers an unusual take on the "Golden Anthem" legend.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Friends, it's been too long. I gather you were also listening in on that conversation about the Golden Anthem's last work?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: What did you mean by Daemons?

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Resentful of the Order's verdict, they committed to paper a curse upon Rinascita and Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Those favored by the Divinity were the most willing to raise the blade of rebellion, for they alone knew how to make Divinity bleed and doctrines crumble.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Though they died in exile to a great fire, their resentment festered in their music and poetry, transforming into horrors known as Daemons.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: This article was recently published in the Ragunna Literary Journal... Quite the perspective, wouldn't you say? Vengeance borne of resentment—such dark and twisted characters are hard to resist.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Perhaps someone unwittingly played that tune just now and opened the Plushies to possession by the Daemons.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Ms. Margherita!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: {PlayerName}, we'll begin when you're ready.
Let's do it. I believe in you.

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Well, hello, hello! If it isn't {PlayerName} and Ciaccona!
The two of you already know each other?

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Oh, Miss Ciaccona is a regular around here, you know. I've even asked her to perform a few times. Helps bring in the crowds!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Actually, I've come to ask a favor of you today, Ms. Margherita. I'm sure you've heard the rumors circulating lately...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: About the Poets Society's legacy. There's something important we'd like to share. Could you help us gather everyone?

speaker: NPC #1490
anh_en: Not a problem at all! Did you make any big discoveries? I'm so curious about what actually happened. It's driving me nuts!
Margherita agrees to your request and begins to gather an impressive crowd...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You and Ciaccona take your place on an impromptu "stage," the curtain poised to rise.

speaker: NPC #1318
anh_en: Laureate, is this all real? What do you mean by the truth? Did you discover something?

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Your presentation brings me back to a play I wrote in my youth.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: A group of birds locked inside a cage. Convinced they will never fly, they do nothing but stand on a perch.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Then one day, the cage door opened. The young birds flapped their fragile wings attempting to fly, but plummeted to the ground one by one.

speaker: NPC #50080
anh_en: Many consider their fate a tragic one. What say you?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: ...I see it differently.

speaker: NPC #150036

The great fire burned everything to ashes.
They weren't the ones that boarded the Pilgrim's Sail.

This is how it all started. A mysterious person showed the poets the truth about the Sentinel. Then they decided to become Knights of Ragunna. \nBack then, besides the conductor, there were others who helped organize things. That was us, the Toccata family.
As for the fire... the poets started it themselves...

In the past, everyone thought they were brilliant cantors. But inside, only they understood how fake and arrogant all their poems and music really were. \nIn their last moments before death, the poets just wanted to leave something real behind. But it was so cold out at sea, and wood for fire was already running low...\nSo they set the cabin on fire and met their ends in the flames.

In the world they dreamed of, poets would no longer be shackled and everyone could sing freely. That was their wish for the future when the curtain fell.\n"With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold."
But the Order was afraid. They didn't want any loose ends, so they went to salvage the ship's wreckage...
The poets gave their legacy to the Toccata family...
Those poems were already cursed...
The Toccata family were also banished...

The Golden Anthem gave my father the key. At first, he wouldn't let me near it because I was too little.\nIt wasn't until my mother, my uncle, and the rest of my family were one by one escorted onto Pilgrim's Sails... Then, it was his turn.
I still remember the day he handed me the key... The smile on his face.
Don't see it as a burden, my child. Remember, true courage isn't hiding it away in your heart. Raise it like a torch, just like the sun, so it can light the way for others.
Only this kind of courage can rid your father of the cowardice he showed toward you and your mother... Never forget, you are a Toccata.

Father wanted to tell everyone, so the Order put him on a Pilgrim's Sail with the same charges. And... that was the last time I saw him.\nLater, after I became a wandering bard and poet, I started to feel what was in the melodies of the poets and my ancestors... A sincerity like none other.
I wrote songs, weaving the stories my father and the poets discovered into musical scores...\nBut what awaited me... was the Order's banishment.

It didn't take long for the Order to notice us. To keep everyone safe, they gave my father a key to a study. \nInside, there were papers that could've destroyed the Order... if anyone would even believe them in the first place.  \nIt was blasphemy... but my father didn't hesitate. He took the key right away.

The Poets Society and our family could never prove whether the Sentinel's form is really that of a Celestial Steed.\nAll we could do was hold onto our suspicions and the possible truth... waiting for someone to prove it.\nNow... that someone has come. {Male=He;Female=She} has reached the inverted tower.
Now, I have that choice again—Do I reveal the truth?\nAlways worrying about my next meal, wandering from place to place, being chased by Acolytes... I'm used to it.

But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. \nIf we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...
{PlayerName}: Like I said, the truth exists to be uncovered. I've made my choice. And once everyone hears the truth, I believe no one will question the choices you all made in the past.
{PlayerName}: (There are hints of the sea inside Ciaccona's melodies.) You should take greater pride in being a poet.
Thank you... Thank you for understanding everything.\nLet's open the doors. I hope this time the story ends differently.
Was the fire on the Pilgrim's Sail really an accident?
As you've already seen, I was also banished. You've probably heard a lot about the Pilgrim's Sail from Brant.

Usually, the food and water on those ships aren't enough to get the people where they need to go. Even if they made it, the cold would get them. \nBut on that ship, the Order made sure there was nothing. No food, no water, nothing. And there were only three "Fools" onboard.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna.
Is that really going to happen?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Unverifiable, yes, but not entirely dismissible. That said, a peculiar entity did indeed manifest, and it attacked you.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: So, let's start at the very beginning. I have a friend who's an expert in deciphering music. I believe you've met her before...

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: She who resembles Topaz should still be near Whisperwind Haven at this hour.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Neither official nor private records show them as having ever "repented" in the Cathedral of Mercury.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: This melody is fading fast. {PlayerName}, let's check if there's anything nearby to amplify it.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: I knew this was to be our fate.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: From the moment we uncovered that lithograph, I knew it would come to this.

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: Still, I have no regrets... But if the Sentinel's true form is a flying steed, what does that make the Imperator we've pledged our faith to?

speaker: NPC #200029
anh_en: All this time, we've been living nothing but a lie！

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The Order's stance is that the Poets Society concealed blasphemous works, yet the Order themselves concealed the lithograph's existence. What were they afraid of?
The Poets Society discovered the Sentinel's true form.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: That's right! You must've seen the Sentinel in the Inverted Tower...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: To keep the Sentinel's true form a secret, the Order ruined the Golden Anthem's reputation.
As you touch Faroll’s Remnant melody, it becomes clear that he had already foreseen this fate. The truth behind their capture was not blasphemy, but the discovery of the true face of the Sentinel.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: {PlayerName}, Carlotta, it's been too long!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Anyway, the two of you came in such a hurry. I suppose you're not here to take in the music.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Oh so... So you eavesdropped on a man rambling on in C3-sharp, and then poof, out pops a "monster"?
You're missing the point!
How sharp is C3-sharp?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It is the point! I need to know what kind of music could possibly have the power to conjure up those "monsters" of yours.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Let me see... it should sound something like this! About that sharp, {PlayerName}.
Yup, and just as grating.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I know right? We should suggest to Ms. Margherita that she add new signage: "Sing with civility, it starts with us!"

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Ahem, can we discuss restaurant etiquette later?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Of course. But I still need to know what kind of music could possibly have the power to conjure up those "monsters" of yours.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: You really must adore that song. I remember hearing you sing it when I was little.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The Golden Anthem... that name should never be spoken.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: They're criminals. To conspire with them is to risk banishment at sea, or worse.
That's okay.
The Order of the Deep can't harm us one bit.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Don't worry. This won't be the first time we've crossed paths with the Order.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: ...Fine.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: From what you've told me, the composers of this poem cursed Rinascita spelling the fall of Ragunna.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: When the poem is played some type of horror appears. If I understand correctly, that's what attacked you and Carlotta.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: If you ask me this story is a right load of codswallop. I don't believe a simple little poem could curse Rinascita.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Then you...
You knew each other as children?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: We need to get to the heart of this poem and music mystery. Let me join you. I can't resist a good adventure.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I'll help you find the link between the music and those Daemons. But in return, I want you to hand these pages to me for safekeeping.
It's just a few sheets of paper.
Sure, no problem.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Then we have a deal!

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Since you believe this music summons them, how about we test it for ourselves? I've already memorized the sheet music.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: It's risky, but there's no surer way to find out, wouldn't you agree, {PlayerName}?
Seeing is believing.
I'm well prepared.
I'm ready to fight.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The final work of poets banished to distant seas and condemned to death...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: What, I wonder, did the verses forged in flames truly sing of?
Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery. After some persuasion, she agrees to help. To uncover the truth, Ciaccona decides to play the melody once more.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Oh, I remember it well! Those two guards of yours were like giants from Septimont, easily two hundred pounds of pure muscle!

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Back then Ciaccona's family conducted the Order's choir.
Then why is Ciaccona a wandering bard?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: How should I put it... Well, as they say, families are always rising and falling.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: But a song is a song whether sung in a grand hall or beneath the open sky. As for family matters... let the past stay where it belongs.

speaker: NPC #200028
anh_en: Faroll's gone mad! He ought to have hidden the truth in our secret study...

speaker: NPC #200028
anh_en: Why would he slip this dangerous knowledge into his poems and hand them out to children?

speaker: NPC #200028
anh_en: We ought to have buried the truth!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Buried the truth...
What are you thinking?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It just occurred to me... is that our mastermind's true aim? Not only to bury the past, but also to silence those who know the truth—like you.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: To that end, he stirs panic to deepen Ragunnesi prejudice against the Poets Society, using this opportunity to create monsters born from our words...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Words and music are weapons without form.
You encounter Rimbaud’s Remnant melody. Unlike Faroll, he believes the truth should remain buried forever, never to be shared through poems.

speaker: NPC #200034
anh_en: I understand what Faroll was trying to do...

speaker: NPC #200034
anh_en: We're not adventurers or mighty Resonators. We don't even have the time or ability to determine whether that lithograph is real or fake.

speaker: NPC #200034
anh_en: Faroll only wanted to share the voice of uncertainty. He hoped someone might understand his doubts...

speaker: NPC #200034
anh_en: Our fate has been sealed. All we can do now is choose what we believe, and carry what we hope to be the truth to our graves.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: They don't sound like they're full of hatred at all. If anything, they appear to have anticipated what would happen.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: During the interrogation, they kept their composure and did not offer fierce resistance. In fact, they even showed sympathy for the interrogator.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: Everything seems to revolve around the Order. Could they be the ultimate mastermind behind this?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: We don't know that for certain, but at least we now know the Poets Society would never place a curse on Ragunna.

You then reach Selena’s Remnant melody. She understands Faroll’s choice, seeing that while they could have let the truth buried with them, they still had the choice to believe and hope. It was this hope that led Faroll to share the truth through his poems.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The melody is fading faster now and becoming unstable. We should leave. We can continue our discussion later.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: Aflame... Celestial Steed... True form I behold...
Let's follow her for now.
As you wander through the Realm of Melodies, you lose track of Ciaccona and find yourself in a study, where a young girl is singing.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: This... is a poem I've never seen before. It's so different from what they used to write.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: Do not place flowers on my tomb, for I do not rest beneath the stone.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: I am the sea wind at Ragunna's walls. I am a dawn that breaks through thorns.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the <te href=800011>Celestial Steed</te>, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Let's pick up where we left off. What stories lie within these melodies?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Do you feel it? The breeze from Whisperwind Haven. You can even catch the faint scent of wet grass.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Next thing you know, maybe an apple will fall on our heads. Or maybe a big gray wolf will leap out and chase a squirrel down a rabbit hole...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Thank you, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I don't have the Blessed Maiden's miracles, nor the powers of a hero. I'm just a wandering bard.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The only thing I can offer is to immortalize this moment. I will carry all the stories about you with me...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: By the way, I met a man at Margherita's who claims to be a playwright. You should watch out for him!
A playwright?
I've met a playwright before as well...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I'm not entirely sure who he really is... But my guess is that he might be the Resonator who's been working with the Order.
I'll keep that in mind.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Here, you can have this music sheet! I'm heading off on a new mission!
What kind of mission?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: An escape mission! Starting today, I'm no longer just a wandering bard. I've got the Order hunting me now! A journey like this? It's begging to be written into a story.
Then I...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Don't you worry! I still remember our promise.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: About the song I wrote you... We will meet again, and I'll sing it for you, I swear!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: After all, we're partners in crime now!

Once the performance is over, Ciaccona warns you to watch out for a playwright in the city. Being wanted as a criminal, she will soon need to run again. This is your farewell, though not the last time you will meet.

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: The night sky will be illuminated by wings aflame, and I shall be reborn in immortal poetry.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: ... Because they cannot banish the truth, the Order of the Deep instead banished us to the sea...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: Our thirst for truth is why we were cast out...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: No matter what, remember this: the truth will always exist. And the truth is "gold" that is unafraid of the fiercest of flames...

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: (I can't get through... but the sounds are coming from over there...)

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: What-what is this place... Who are you?

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: She's always been distant and aloof, but her true melody is both heavy and fragile...

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: Ciaccona Toccata...

speaker: NPC #200027
anh_en: As long as you still draw breath, lift your eyes and look. With this poem, your life is eternal.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: They are... just like the ones that attacked us in the restaurant.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: It seems someone told the poets the truth about the Sentinel, and even suggested they stop singing solely for Divinity and begin singing for the common folk as well.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: On the surface, what our "mystery man" said makes perfect sense. He even has knowledge of Imperator's true form.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: And this hidden lithograph is evidence the poets were telling the truth...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: We may find ourselves straddling vast rifts in time and space. A single misstep could draw us into other melodies leaving us lost within them.
Careful!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: But what we've seen isn't like that, no. They're more like horrors created from peoples' words and imagination.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Of course, I'm just speculating. The voices were somewhat muddled. Perhaps I can refine the melody. This time we need to listen harder.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Let's find out what the true story really is...
The Daemons reappear. After defeating them, Ciaccona draws closer, hoping to use her Forte to uncover the story hidden in the frequencies.

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: They burned in despair, resentful of the Order's verdict till their last breath. Their last work is nothing but a curse upon us all!

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold. Is it saying Ragunna will burn to the ground??

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: They wanted their resentment to echo through the streets... Just by reading this, I can almost see their terrifying faces in the fire!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: These voices... they're people of Ragunna, aren't they? I think I heard Mr. C3-sharp in the mix.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: If the poets' resentful souls gave birth to Daemons, then shouldn't they sound like the poets themselves?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Those voices were just people who read or heard their work...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Perhaps the voices themselves are what causes the Daemons to manifest.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: In the legends, Daemons are born of death and curses.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Music and poetry are born from kindness and hope... yet now they've been twisted to create these monstrosities...
Where should we begin our investigation?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: If we find the <te href=800012>Melody</te> connected to the Poets Society, I can bring the past into clearer focus...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I've got it, {PlayerName}. I know a place where they've definitely left their mark.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Let's go! Onward, to new melodies!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Whoever is behind this won't just sit back and watch.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: ...The thought of confronting them is already inspiring me to write a ballad! What should I call it? Which instruments would fit...

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Our enemy hides in the dark, while we remain in the light. If that's the case...

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: We need to split up. With your tenacity and Ciaccona's expertise, we will uncover the truth.
And Opal?

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: Someone has pointed a gun at Cat's Eye. Someone ought to pull back the curtain and expose them.

speaker: NPC #50001
anh_en: The family has its ways. Tracing the article's source and finding this mastermind won't be a problem.
So, where do we start?
What is this place?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: To be honest... I haven't found any leads either. But worry not, this is what we bards call a "bottleneck."

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Once, I spent three days just trying to find the right words to describe a tree... couldn't do it. Not one word.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So I stood under that tree and prayed for an apple to fall on my head.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: You know, just like in those stories where inspiration strikes after an apple hits you. And, well... at least you'd get a snack out of it.
So did an apple hit you?
So did inspiration find you?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Sadly, the apples weren't ripe and none fell. No free nibbles for me, unfortunately.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: The apples never fell. I stood under that tree until I couldn't any longer, but still no inspiration came.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Try it!

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: It's a real apple...

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Ta-da! Welcome to <te href=800010>Requiem Paradise</te>!

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Later, when I finally decided to leave, I looked up through the gaps in the branches and suddenly saw a blooming flower atop a cliff.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Turns out, even without an apple, inspiration may yet strike. But if I hadn't stood there, I might've missed that unexpected burst of beauty.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: So… maybe this is enough. Let's put aside heavy thoughts and continue our walk with a clear mind.

speaker: NPC #750088
anh_en: I'm starting to understand why Carlotta calls you <ano=Sunlit>"Topaz"</ano>.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Is that so? But I'm nowhere near as dazzling as the sun. If anything, I'd rather be like Icarus in the story.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Soaring freely in the sky, even if it means... falling in the end.
To learn more, you need more melodies. Ciaccona takes you to a moonlit shore, a place where Ragunna's poets and musicians are known to bury their instruments. There, you might find new clues.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: This is where Ragunna's musicians lay their old instruments to rest.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: For the people of Ragunna, the sea is everything. We live and sleep by the sea, and our souls drift out to sea when we pass.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Since an instrument is an extension of the musician, it's only fitting that it's buried by the sea. May its dreams be long and sweet before returning to the waves.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I'm certain this is where the poets of the Golden Anthem laid their instruments to rest before their banishment.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: What's wrong? You seem troubled.
Have you found any leads?

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: Is that what's been on your mind this whole time? I say, if the answers aren't coming, let it all go and clear your mind.

speaker: NPC #150036
anh_en: I sense the melody of an instrument close by. Let's search for it.

Sakura Quarter

Once hailed as "Honami City's most beautiful living quarter," Sakura Quarter was a place where cherry blossoms framed the rows of residences in a picturesque harmony. Cross the blossom-shaped footbridge and walk a few blocks, and you would see the famous "Sakura Upon Water" spot, a favorite for young lovers. The housing prices here, however, were anything but beautiful.\n\nIn the past, the neighborhood was safe, uneventful, and almost free of ghost stories. But after the Lament, tales began to spread. Many speak of the "Mysterious Scissorswoman," a black-haired, red-eyed schoolgirl. At times, she leaps from rooftops, drifting down like a crow's feather. At others, she flashes across the streets, cutting through TDs with her giant scissors. Some say she came from Hell, others call her a hero of justice, while a few whisper that her figure in battle resembles the legendary miko herself.

Even before the Lament, Meishin Passageway was already a fixture among Honami's urban legends. In the strictest sense, it refers to a passage connecting two parallel tunnels in the Commercial District, open only during certain times of the year. Many residents swore they heard strange noises, saw traffic cones gathering on their own, or felt a tap on the shoulder, only to turn and find no one.\n\nThough the city hall insisted that it was just an old service passage from construction, this hardly deterred the thrill-seekers. Over the years, tales multiplied. Some claimed that ten minutes inside meant a full day outside. The best-known story came from a local radio interview. A man said the passageway had granted his wish by letting him see his long-departed family... His proof was a limited-edition Namipon plushie with a unique serial number, which was thought to be destroyed in a fire, but somehow appeared in the passageway.

Hanakage Underground Street was originally part of Honami's subway system, and was later repurposed into a cultural passage themed around contemporary art. Before the Lament, quarterly film festivals and exhibitions filled the streets with artworks from across Ashinohara. The gift shops sold unique souvenirs that could only be found in Honami.\n\nOf all its events, the annual "Honami Urban Legend Exhibition" always drew the largest crowds. Submissions ranged from amateur films by students to pieces by renowned photographers of the Pioneer Association. One anonymous short film went almost unnoticed at the time of its debut, but years later, it resurfaced in public debate. Countless interpretations sprang up, as tales in the film began to manifest in reality, one by one: "The Migrating Fish Windsocks," "The Wish-Granting Passageway," and "The Midnight Ghost Bus."

Contrary to popular memory, the park around Neon Tower predates the tower itself. In fact, Neon Tower was sited here precisely because the park's open grounds would minimize radio interference. After the tower's completion, the original Honami City Park was expanded into Honami Central Park, a proud symbol of the city center. At the time, it also stood as the largest park in all of Ashinohara.\n\nIts first urban legend came shortly after staff began hanging fish windsocks. One morning, they discovered that every windsock, once scattered across the park, had gathered above the innermost garden. Not long after, the Pioneer Association published a grainy, shocking video captured by a citizen staying late there one night: under the moonlight, many windsocks glided through the sky toward a single spot, as if they were alive...
