Not long ago, it left a note saying it went to the park for ninja training. After that, no word. But come to think of it, have you noticed the new Namipon statues under <color=#d08c0f>the wisteria tree in Central Park</color>? Could that be its doing?
This Namipon is the type to hit every single spot in the guidebook when visiting somewhere new. By now, it's probably already wandered to <color=#d08c0f>Central Park</color>.

Parks are often refuges for the downhearted. The Left Behind here say it's often seen alone in <color=#d08c0f>a pavilion</color>, staring blankly into the air. Ah, such is the melancholic world of an adult capybara.

I never really got this Namipon's way of speaking. Last I saw, it was wandering <color=#d08c0f>in a residential park near Sakura Quarter</color>. Oh, and those ad banners by the store... Wait, why aren't they in the same style?

If I remember right, this Namipon loves a good view with pastries. And around here, the best view has to be where <color=#d08c0f>sakura petals drift across the water</color>. You'll probably find it there.

Honestly, this Namipon might be the bravest of the lot… though of course I'm still better. Last sighting was in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>, where most of Honami's urban legends are set.

This one works in Honami's <color=#d08c0f>Commercial District</color>, serrated with office buildings and malls. But in that concrete jungle, there's a <color=#d08c0f>giant cherry blossom tree</color> so tall its branches cover the sky... I wonder how it got that big.

As a pro detective, I can say with certainty this Namipon is hiding in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>—the stage of countless urban legends. It also loves to leave riddles that only it finds challenging. If you spot any <color=#d08c0f>odd objects around</color>, that's probably its work.

One of my fellow capybaras swears they saw it in <color=#d08c0f>the underground street</color>, being chased by a Tacet Discord. But they call it the Student with Ultimate Luck, so it'll probably be fine... I guess.
This one's drawn to water, so keep an eye on <color=#d08c0f>pools around here</color>. A capybara disguised as a mermaid should be... *relatively* easy to spot, right?

Though all Namipons have a passion for food, this one's appetite is… on a whole other level. Maybe that's its special trait... maybe.

A traveler with a sunhat, always off exploring, once even tried to submit travel journals to the Pioneer Association.

Sure, simple lines of code are capable of simulating Night City's basest joys: power, influence, fat paychecks, sprawling villas, floor-to-ceiling windows, the list goes on. But no matrix, no algorithm, no matter how complex, can model the human heart. Gotta ask yourself a simple question: Would you rather live in peace as a nobody, or go down for all times in a blaze of glory?

Gonks who might mistake this place as an oasis, as some escape from their troubles, will learn the hard way. There's no such thing as a "fresh start." Toss aside your past life all you want, but old debts will always come due.
Sit down, close your eyes, get your eddies at the ready, and witness your wildest fantasies turn to reality in an instant. How long will it last, you ask? Depends how many BDs you can pony up for.

Between the restlessness of a neon-soaked city and the peace of a distant moon, what would you choose? A girl already accustomed to the grime of those streets looked up to moon one day and made her choice. She eventually reached her goal, but the price proved far more costly than she could've imagined.

Money and the luxuries it provides don't extend into this barren land of nightmares. But maybe life on the road isn't so bad. Riding a motorcycle, chromatic rock blasting at max volume – sounds preem, no doubt. Just don't let any ghouls hiding in roadside ditches leave you with a flat.

Dismantled, reassembled, redundancies removed – only acid rain and the relics of industry remain. Above shimmers a digital paradise in a sea of stars. While, below, a hellscape of concrete and steel burns and scars.

Filter out the noise, peel back the layers. Might be surprised to discover no one cares about the truth. Out there, the toxic fumes of desire rise like a haze from the streets. Either you choose to keep running, or sin and suffering will catch up to you.

In this city, even the digital can dream. Data, whether stored on a server or in a meat brain, inevitably tries to carve a path for itself forward. How and why does this always happen? Does code have a soul?

anh_en: Oh, and feel free to display photos publicly on the Commemoration Wall. Share your most spectacular moments!
Mt. Firmament

Beyond the southeastern sea of Jinzhou lies the secluded realm of Mt. Firmament. It is said that Sentinel Jué once graced this ancestral homeland of the Jinzhou people with its presence.\nNow, however, this snowy peak is perpetually shrouded in mist, sealed away from commoners. Rumor has it that time flows eerily slowly there, almost as if it is stagnant...
Huanglong: Mt. Firmament
Black Shores: Surface

The Black Shores rests itself on an isle veiled in dense sea fog—a safe haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering the world. Without an invitation from its members, none has ever been able to locate this floating ark that connects the world in the vast ocean...
Black Shores: Archipelago
Black Shores: Underground

The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...
Black Shores: Subterranean Galaxy
Rinascita

Scattered islands give rise to united civilizations. Their bonds are woven through bloodlines, their purpose driven by the welfare of their families. What changes might a roving warrior bring to their shores?
Riccioli Islands

A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
Rinascita: Riccioli Islands
Averardo Vault

A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times. The ensemble of the dazzling array of collections forms the construct of “art” itself.
Rinascita: Averardo Vault
Avinoleum

Divine ruins that hang upside down in the sky. Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds.\n\nIt once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
Rinascita: Avinoleum
Septimont

“All for glory, fear no death." Like Ragunna, Septimont is a city-state of Rinascita, though its people revere not Divinity, but heroes of flesh and blood.\nFamed for its Gladiators, this City of Glory is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years.”
Rinascita: Septimont
Fabricatorium of the Deep

A hidden facility at the depths of the sea. It serves as the distribution center for the Common Echoes. Few truly understand its full purpose.\nBeneath the calm lies madness, and at the end of the madness is a collection of unfulfilled, lingering desires.
Rinascita: Fabricatorium of the Deep
Sanguis Plateaus

The Sanguis Plateaus serve as both Septimontians' hunting grounds and the first line of defense against the Dark Tide. On these magnificent yet bleak highlands, the Blightcloud hovering above stirs relentlessly.\n\nHere, power and glory reach their peak, then give way to bloodshed and death.
Rinascita: Sanguis Plateaus
Honami

A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.

Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream...\nThat Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.
Huanglong I - Act VII
To the Shore's End
Your story begins in Jinzhou. Yet recent mysteries lead you on a path towards an archipelago shrouded in fog—the Black Shores. Perhaps these solitary shores will mark the End of Wandering for you...
Chapter I: Act VIII
Even When Divinity Remains Silent

A masquerade that never ends, with music that never sleeps... During the Carnevale, people cast off the chains of society and reveal their truest selves. But now, the city is drowned in silence. Will your arrival lift the veil of quiet, and bring back the joy and song to the streets?
Chapter II
The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

In search of Sentinel Imperator, you follow Their guidance and uncover a crucial clue: "Seek the ruins suspended above the wasteland."

As you journey toward the hidden ruins among the clouds, Cantarella, the head of the Fisalias, unveils a long-buried history. Along the way, you also cross paths once again with the mysterious girl, Cartethyia.

Ascending the stairs, the truth is finally within your grasp. However, what awaits beyond is far more unexpected...
Chapter II Act IV
Shadow of Glory

Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita’s city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...
Chapter II Act V
Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens

After the Great Agon, Cartethyia once again felt the lingering power of the Threnodian. You journey to the sea in search of answers, but are met with resistance from Fenrico, the Primus of the Order, who desires for you to sink forever in the deep. But Phrolova saves you from the raging waves.\nThe unknown ocean depths, enemies with unforeseen actions, and a gem coveted by many... everything swirls like a current, pulling you into its grasp. Where will this underwater adventure lead?
Chapter II Act VII
By Sun's Burning Hand

As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival. To recover the lost relic of Sentinel Imperator and halt the Dark Tide before it devours Rinascita once more, you and the Gladiators of Septimont set out for the expedition...\n\nBut in the unforgiving wilds of the Sanguis Plateaus, the boundary between the hunter and hunted is perilously thin. Who truly holds the reins of fate? And who shall rise to wear the crown of glory? Only the victor has the right to answer.
Chapter II Act VIII
Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides

Following the defeat of the False Sovereign, Rinascita enjoys a brief period of tranquility. To open the Civilization Capsule left by Imperator, you and Abby prep for Ragunna to find Cartethyia, only to discover that the people of Ragunna are being plagued by nightmares. Meanwhile, inside the Inverted Tower, Avinoleum, the returning Discord Slayer fires her pistol at the once Blessed Maiden...\nWith Cartethyia's "death," the Fractsidus's "story" in Rinascita approaches its final chapter. Leviathan has been reborn from the Gem, and the prophesied Journeying Paradise makes its descent. Even though no Divinity remains on this land, familiar faces have begun to take action to prevent Rinascita's doom. Bearing everyone's will, you are determined to step into the Dark Tide...
Chapter II Act X & XI
Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands

With events in Rinascita finally over, you return once more to the Black Shores to find them investigating abnormal frequencies in nearby waters. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you… At this point, where time is frozen, sever the endless loop and embrace the dawn of the future.
Chapter II Act XII
What Burns Beneath Frostlands
The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!
Chapter III Act I
The Star That Voyages Far

After the New Solar Ceremony, your campus life kicks off. In class, you cross paths with a "ghost girl," Aemeath, a Synchronist presumed dead more than a decade ago. Why is she lingering at the Academy? What's her connection with you? To uncover the truth about her and the root cause of your fading frequency, you and Aemeath set out for the Roya Frostlands, where the Exostrider slumbers.
Chapter III Act III
Gold Suspended in Shadows

As the New Solar Celebration kicks off, the air of Startorch Academy is filled with festivity. Yet beneath the surface, abnormal frequencies fester within the Academy's Dark Side, a subconscious dimension birthed from students' emotions. At President Lucilla's request, you take a dive into this psychic realm, where you encounter Sigrika—a spirited honor student hailed as a future successor to the Heliodic Six. As you venture forth, it soon becomes clear that the riddles and murmurs haunting the Dark Side harbor a far more sinister intent...
Chapter III Act IV
Starlights from Yesterdays

With the Academy's Dark Side incident resolved, your pursuit of the Fractsidus brings you briefly face-to-face with an aloof white-haired miko who wields a blade. But before the Exostrider can awaken, the Threnodian in the underground Dimmr Plains begin flaring with alarming frequency, forcing the Spacetrek Collective to consider an emergency evacuation of Lahai-Roi. To keep the Exostrider plan alive, you move into action. And as the Void Storm spreads, Aemeath's ever-silent "shell" seems to be whispering to herself...
Chapter III Act V
At Dream's Edge

A strange gate appears out of nowhere at Startorch Academy. Behind it, reality-invading frequencies leak through. To investigate the crisis, you step through the threshold and into the Somnoire, where you encounter Lucy and Rebecca as they battle a swarm of Nightmare Tacet Discords. But as you explore further, you uncover an unlikely truth…

Magistrate Jinhsi insists that I take some time off work. The streets tonight are bustling with life. Since I have little to do, I imbibed some... floral brew. My body is warm yet my heart longs for someone to confide in.

It is a common practice to don monster masks as part of a ceremonial dance ritual. Folks here believe their reenactment of monsters from the legends of Huanglong may ward off evil and invite good fortune. As for me... I do not need the reenactment, for I have worked hard to suppress the monster within, which is already a perfect mask for me.

Those strange sights and sounds in the cold wind and snow are the past that I cannot sever. But because of you all, I see the silver lining behind these macabre scenes. You give me the strength to pray for the return of spring.

The fate you've sown will bear fruit in the coming years. Should you leave on another journey, please remember to take my... and our blessings with you.

Sanhua

This year's ceremony is different—it is the first one free of the Threnodian menace. People are finally able to laugh and rejoice from the heart, and I truly enjoy seeing everyone smile.

I've told Sanhua and Taoqi to take a break. After working all year, they deserve leisure time to bask in this hard-won warmth. When I see others happily reunited with their families, I can't help but yearn for your presence. I knew you had matters to attend to, but your absence during the most festive days in a year would have made everyone a bit lonely.

So, when you came back with guests from Rinascita, I was truly happy—you really do miss Jinzhou enough to spend time with me. Perhaps, in your heart, Jinzhou has become your home.

I wrote a song to express my gratitude, and it seems I'll finally get to sing it. Wearing the ceremonial dress still makes me a bit shy, but if you like, I'll wear it properly after I finish work and sing just for you.

Jinhsi

I hope this letter finds you well.

Jinhsi and Sanhua were overjoyed by the glowing reviews of the Hero Play from the guests of Rinascita. After a year of hard work, they can finally set aside their duties and enjoy a well-deserved respite.

Your Rinascitan friends were eager to share thrilling tales of the Laureate with me, and I found their stories about you both delightful and heartwarming. It is truly gratifying to see the profound impact your journey has had on the lives of others.

However, I believe it is time for you to take some proper rest now, after the busyness of the Hero Play and the joy of welcoming your friends. During your absence, several notable events transpired in Jinzhou. If you are interested, I would be happy to recount them to you at your leisure.

The day before your return to Jinzhou, the winter's last snowstorm breathed a delicate layer of snow on our Go checkerboard, on which I wrote a wish.

By the time you receive this letter, it will have already come true.

Changli

(A neatly penned letter bearing a wobbly and crooked signature)

Hmph, this is a letter I wrote you. Surprised? Yeah me too. I mean, if there's something I need to say to you, I could just tell you in person, right? But everyone else was scribbling away so I asked Sanhua to write down what I was saying.

When I think about it, we've really been through a lot, haven't we? From Huanglong to the Black Shores and then onto Rinascita. From Loong Buns and Coral Bowl to Pizza Tropicale. Although our trip had its rough patches, in the end, nothing could hold us back.

<s>Mmmh...hmm, so what do I wish for...? Wait no, don't write that down!</s>

I wish from this day on we'll always be well-fed and happy. Oh, and if you ever run into trouble, don't forget to call me. Your business is my business too.

Abby

This is a letter from Carlotta Montelli. I hope this did not come as a surprise.

It wasn't until I lifted my pen that I realized this was not the first time I had written to you. You had known me through my invitation to you to Rinascita, long before we met in person. That was where it all began.

Fate brought you before me. Together, we captured the traitor within my family and took part in Ragunna's grandest Carnevale. Breaking conventions and revealing all to an outsider was a first for me, but with you, everything came so naturally.

This time, when I received your invitation, I did not hesitate to accept. The cultures of those beyond Rinascita are fascinating, and I'm thoroughly intrigued by the Hero Plays of Jinzhou. But what really captivates me are the aspects of you that I have yet to explore.

If my initial invitation led you to reciprocate, then perhaps a heartfelt expression of sincerity might elicit an equally precious response. 

Would you dance with me if I took the first step?

I wrote this letter after watching the play. Pero was happily stuffed after she ate all the petals on stage. She was as satisfied as everyone else.

The waves bring many things—sometimes a discarded bottle, sometimes a broken sail, and sometimes a precious Luceanite. Then one day, you and the captain braved the waves and reached our troupe. At the time, I never imagined you would be such a joy and inspiration to me and Pero.

I took the funny stories you told me and turned them into commedia to give hope and courage to our happy troupe. I hope you will be the first audience for my new play, since it's about your travels. I haven't decided on the finale yet, but perhaps, like your journey, it should have no end.

May the wind always be at your back and the sun upon your face. Next time we meet, regale me with dazzling stories.

Roccia

My dearest friend, thank you for the invitation. I had heard much about Huanglong's Hero Plays, but attending one in person has truly revealed their magnificence!

There's magic to a great performance where actors pour their very souls into their craft. A tale told from the stage can grow to encompass the world! And the audience too becomes part of that world, immersed in the character's joys and sorrows.

I am always fascinated by performances that evoke such feelings. Therefore, the troupe and I have prepared a new play. Care to guess the plot? Well, think back to when we first met—how one hero braved the sea to conquer the storm and be crowned with the Laurel of the Carnevale!

A hero's journey always deserves flowers and applause. We want people to know of your thrilling exploits and to feel the passion and romance of a roving life. Come, my friend! You must not miss the show!
(Enclosed are two front-row tickets)

Brant

anh_en: Which means he's...

speaker: NPC #1369

speaker: NPC #1369

speaker: NPC #1367

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: I was just as surprised as you were when I first found out that "Xiaosheng" was actually Shifan. The two of us grew up together, went to school together, and entered the Academy together.

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: He's always been the center of attention, easygoing, always fitting in effortlessly...

speaker: NPC #1367
anh_en: You were eavesdropping on our conversation. Please explain your behavior.

speaker: NPC #1370

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: Every time I asked him, he'd always wriggle his way out of it. And... he started distancing himself from me and even transferred himself to another project team.

speaker: NPC #1370

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: So... I have a request.

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: I want to know what kind of wish he made... And if possible, I want to help make it come true. I want to know what happened to him.

anh_en: Which makes me feel even more worried for him.

speaker: NPC #1370

speaker: NPC #1370

speaker: NPC #1370

anh_en: Oh, Yangyang! What's there to be shy about? If you want to see {PlayerName}, just tell {Male=him;Female=her}!

speaker: Chixia
anh_en: So, what have you been up to these past few days? Feelin' lonely without us around?

speaker: NPC #1369

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: It wasn't until I sat alone in the empty lab that I realized... Maybe everything I sacrificed, even my friend's future, was all for nothing.

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: But when I lie in bed awake at night, I feel regret all over again. I know I can't give up Echo research. My obsession torments me, but I don't deserve to pursue it anymore.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Obsession...

speaker: Gleamtender
anh_en: I've heard enough!

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: Pull yourself together already!

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: Jiuli, where did you...?

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: I'll tell you right now, I never blamed you for what happened. I felt the same as you, right from the start!

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: On our path of pursuing new discoveries, I was willing to pay any price. What I don't accept is you calling quits halfway!

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: I'm not done yet!

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: Okay...

speaker: NPC #1370
anh_en: It blows my mind that this is why you stopped talking to me. While I'm at it, you haven't changed a bit since we were kids. You'd get into the habit of running away from any problems you face that are non-research-related!

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: I'm... I'm sorry...

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: It is wonderful to have someone to support you on the journey to achieve greatness in research.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: It seems even without our help, this wish has been fulfilled...
I agree with you.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: This in turn indicates that Xiaosheng's wish is not the source of the abnormal codes.
Three more wishes to go.
The mission isn't over yet.

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: {PlayerName}... You're back again? No luck finding Xiaosheng?
You don't deny you are Xiaosheng?

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: I had hurt my friend, given up on a career, and worked on something I wasn't actually interested in.

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: But...
This still isn't resolved?!

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Yes. There are more wishes to decipher.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: I grow ever more confident with you around, {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: ...I appreciate your hard work. It's thanks to you, we were able to fulfill the first wish so quickly.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Now... we should make our way back to the Moontree Lodge.
You signal Xiangli Yao to transfer the Echo data to Shifan's Terminal.

speaker: NPC #1369
anh_en: I chose to continue the testing. That's why he missed the window for treatment.

When you speak with Shifan again, he opens up about his true wish, confessing that he has been burdened with guilt ever since Jiuli was injured in a lab accident. At that moment, Jiuli appears, expressing his feelings. Though the two seem to argue, you can tell that their friendship is strong, and you are certain Shifan's wish will eventually come true.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Hello {PlayerName}, I hope you've been well? Remember how I mentioned that the stall vendors at the Moonlit Fair will adjust their offerings based on everyone's wishes?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Based on the wishes we've received so far, I've thought of a few excellent themes. Maybe we can start preparing for them.

speaker: NPC #1366
anh_en: Wish. Choose...

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Indeed. The wish shows a struggle between her longing and a promise she made to her son.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: She speaks of "another world," likely hinting her child has passed away, leaving her alone with nobody to care for her.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: We can't draw a conclusion solely based on words alone. I'm curious as to what drove her to write these words.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Heying and her son... What's their story? What promise did they share?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: What is it, {PlayerName}? Is there something on your mind?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: No, nothing. It's just that... Is it really for us to take on a wish tied to life and death?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: She knows the pain of separation from a loved one better than anyone else. If we handle this wrong, it might...

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: So that's what you're worried about. It seems what Baizhi said about you is true. You do have a gentle soul.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Ever thought about becoming the mysterious wish granter of Moontree Lodge yourself?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: You're right to be concerned, but... the Moontree Lodge's very existence is to have every wish be heard.
Another one of those sad wishes...

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Ignoring people's pain isn't right. Besides, we're not trying to force Mrs. Heying to make a choice.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Our role is to listen, understand, and reflect. Ultimately, the choice lies in Mrs. Heying's hands.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: But it's getting late. Let me know when you're ready for our next task.
Let's go...
I need to think about it.
The second wish involves a difficult choice. Following the same approach as with Shifan, you decide to track down the wisher, Ms. Heying, and hear her story.
Are they wishing for an answer?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Hmm, this wish does bear some similarities to the one written by Shifan.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: This shows that, just like Shifan, the woman who wrote this wish is desperate for help. We need to consider this carefully.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Their questions might not reflect their deepest wishes, and it's not our place to answer them. It's sad that she seems to be in the same place that Shifan was...

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: But they both wanted help. That is why they made these wishes.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: So aside from helping her make a choice, there are other factors we must consider.
The problem that led their wish?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Ah {PlayerName}, are you ready for our next task?
Let's go...
I need to think about it.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Excuse me. You must be Mrs. Heying. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival.
You must've been happy for him.
You must've been really proud of him.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Once, he and some Rangers stayed behind during a mission to give folks like me a chance to flee.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: I know he did it to chase his dreams, but... but now he's gone, and he'll never witness the defeat of the Threnodians.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: I just... sigh... We used to celebrate every Moon-Chasing Festival at the stalls, and he'd make wishes at the Moontree Lodge.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Haha, yes, I always had faith that my son would achieve his dreams. He never stopped striving.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: His mischief sometimes tried my patience, but now, the silence is overwhelming. I can't help but wonder if... if he's lonely wherever he is? Oh, perhaps I should join him?

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: But before he left, he made me promise to be witness to the day the Threnodians are finally gone. What am I to do...

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Oh dear, I've rambled on about my boy again. What brings you here today, dear?
We... We're here for the wish you made.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Oh, hello... Happy Moon-Chasing Festival. Who might you be?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Do you remember the wish you made at the Moontree Lodge, Mrs. Heying?

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Well, of course. I do. Everyone knows the Moontree Lodge has magical powers. I see, you must've been sent here to help me fulfill my wish, is that right?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: When deciding your answer... Oh yes, {PlayerName}, I recall they say it's best to speak the answer in front of the Moontree Lodge.
Huh?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Xiangli Yao gives you a slight nudge.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Oh. Yes. Absolutely.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Mrs. Heying, might you consider a visit to the Lodge with us? The Taoyuan Vale is preparing for the Moonlit Fair, and the atmosphere is quite lively. Perhaps a walk will lift your spirits.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: A walk... My heart hasn’t really been in it since I lost my son. And, well, my legs don’t carry me as well as they used to...
Let's go together.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: My name is Xiangli Yao, and this is the Rover. I apologize for the unannounced visit, ma'am.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Well... okay. If you think it might help find the answers, then perhaps we should try.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: You granted his wish beautifully. I trust you might do the same for mine, though really, I have nothing much left to ask for.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: As I've mentioned in my wish, I find myself at a crossroads, unable to decide. I hope the Moontree Lodge can clear my doubts.
During your conversation, Ms. Heying shares the promise she made to her late son, Xiuyuan. Wanting to ease her pain, you take her to Taoyuan Vale to experience the festival's joy.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Rover, Rover... why does that sound so familiar...

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Oh, I remember now. You're the hero of Jinzhou, aren't you? Defeated that terrible beast. Everyone's been talking about it.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: My thanks to you. You've realized my son's vision. Oh, how joyful he'd be, seeing Jinzhou now.
Your son's vision?

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Since he was little, my boy dreamed of shielding me, and all of Jinzhou.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: He'd always say, "I'll conquer the Threnodian one day so everyone can live peacefully." That's what drove him to join the Midnight Rangers.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: What was that about?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Hehe...It was just a little trick to get Mrs. Heying to join us at the Lodge. You probably sensed it after hearing her story.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: The promise between Mrs. Heying and her son wasn't just about seeing his wish granted but about finding peace in her life.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: In her grief, Mrs. Heying overlooked what her son truly wished for.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: His wish for his mother represents not just life's simple joys, but also the courage to keep living.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Though I can't say for certain, the Moonlit Fair in Taoyuan Vale holds the dreams of many.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Perhaps there's something her son wanted her to see, a reason to embrace life.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Heh, how are you youngsters falling behind an old lady? Come on, I'm waitin' on ya!

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: I believe he wanted her to see Jinzhou uniting to defeat the Threnodian and the joy and security he sacrificed himself to safeguard.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Indeed it is! Look at the crowd! So many things I've never seen before, it's quite exciting...

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: You young folks must be thrilled with all this. Go on, enjoy yourselves. Don't mind this old lady.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: (Mrs. Heying has been doing her best to stay cheerful since we arrived at Taoyuan Vale. Let's take her to see more of the fair.)

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: This year's Moon-Chasing Festival sure is lively.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Well, well. I see that we have quite a few new faces here today.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: As autumns passed, people gazed at the bright moons. In this border city, the "Tidal Discourse" states, "The tides rise and fall with the moon."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Unlike the joy of "The Fox and the Moon," the Lunite and Threnodians at the borders are linked. Two moons signal disaster.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Hence, "Moon-Chasing" is a race to stop the Threnodians before the Lunite waxes to its fullest. As the people of Jinzhou gaze skyward...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: ...only one full moon remains of the two, casting its glow on Sol 3. The Lunite stays the same, yet everything else changes.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Later, in honor of all those who served, the Magistrate decreed the time of the full moon to be known as the "Moon-Chasing Festival."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Now, instead of racing the moonlight, people follow its glow to find their way home and reunite with loved ones. May such joy be theirs...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Year after year...

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: I'll not bore you with my clumsy words. Instead, let me weave a tale, drawing upon a thread of celestial light to illuminate our discussion.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: As to the origins of the Moon-Chasing Festival, stories vary across Huanglong's states. But the most renowned tale is that of "The Fox and the Moon."

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: As the tale goes, there was once a Sentinel named Hsin, known for its love of merriment and mischief. It is said that the very first Moon-Chasing Festival was its idea.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: During one such celebration, Hsin, in a fit of playfulness, chased the other Sentinels well into the night.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: This night of revelry was passed down through generations, becoming the joyful silhouettes beneath the autumn moonlight. And thus, the tradition of "Moon-Chasing" was born.

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 2
anh_en: Oh, come on, we've heard of this one before. It's even written the Huanglong Compulsory Education Textbook. Page 111. Ya got anything new to tell or not?

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 3
anh_en: Yeah. Boo! I want my money back!

speaker: Diễn Viên Số 1
anh_en: Patience, everyone. Our tale has just reached the gates of Jinzhou. Let me continue.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Happy Moon-Chasing Festival! Would you like to browse our fan paintings?

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: This one is exquisite! Just look at the fireworks bursting to life on the fan. I've never seen anything like it.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: The fireworks seem to fly to the other side of the fan. And these capes...

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: You have excellent taste, ma'am. This fan is the creation of Ms. Zhezhi. It's the Moon-Chasing Festival from her imagination.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: Ah, yes. They represent the Midnight Rangers. A special touch from Ms. Zhezhi.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: She hopes that everyone who sees this fan will feel the liveliness of the Moon-Chasing Festival, and remember that the festivities are all thanks to the brave Rangers.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: The fireworks flying to the other side are meant to share the celebration with the soldiers on the front lines.

speaker: NPC #700036
anh_en: This year's fireworks display will be the biggest yet. Even the soldiers should be able to see it. You won't want to miss it.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: I'd like to buy one of these fans...

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Ah, the Moon Shooter gallery? My son was so good. Every year at the Moonlit Fair, it was his favorite.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Mrs. He... Ahem. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival everyone. Want to give the Moon Shooter game a try? Lots of rewards to be had!
Prizes? Count me in!

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Wow, very impressive shooting skills. Here are your prizes.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: You might not remember, but after Xiuyuan passed, I tried to visit you. You didn't want to see me then. I never expected we'd meet here.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: It's good to see you out and about. Xiuyuan always talked about how good of a mother you were.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: By the way, some of the soldiers who served with Xiuyuan are here today. I'm sure they'd love to see you. Look, here they come.
A group of soldiers walk over to the gallery as Qingxi waves at them.

speaker: NPC #700038
anh_en: It's an honor to finally meet you, Mrs. Heying. Xiuyuan was an incredible mentor to me. I wouldn't have the nerve to wield a weapon now if it wasn't for him.

speaker: NPC #700038
anh_en: I heard you were the one who taught him how to overcome his fear of the water...

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: One by one, the Rangers share their stories of Xiuyuan with Mrs. Heying, as you and Xiangli Yao stand quietly listening on.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: ...So, the boy taught you everything I taught him.

speaker: NPC #700038
anh_en: Mrs. Heying...
It's for Mrs. Heying.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Oh, I'm still here. Please, go on. I'd love to hear more stories about Xiuyuan's time with the Rangers.

speaker: NPC #700037
anh_en: Of course, ma'am. Why don't we go have a seat over there first? We've got plenty of stories to share with you.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Before that... Thank you, Xiangli Yao and {PlayerName}.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Just as I said before. I knew that both of you would make my wish come true.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: But before I visit the Moontree Lodge for the answer, I'd like to walk around a bit more on my own.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: I trust that this answer will be right for you.
Heying thanks you as she follows the Rangers away.

speaker: NPC #700037
anh_en: Mrs. Heying?

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: Yes... Thank you, both.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Qingxi carefully hands the prizes to Mrs. Heying. While not especially luxurious looking, they seem practical.

speaker: Rover
anh_en: Do you think Mrs. Heying understood the promise she made to her son?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: We can't be sure just yet. But at least she's made a good start, don't you agree?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: Now she isn't just going along with us, she's searching for the life her son wanted for her.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: But it means this wasn't the wish affecting Patty either. We'll have to keep digging.

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: At any rate, more stalls are being set up in Taoyuan Vale. Care to explore further...?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: I believe she'll uncover her answer someday and make her own choice, without relying on the Moontree Lodge.
While at the Moon Shooter Stall, you encounter some Midnight Rangers whom Xiuyuan once mentored. They speak fondly of Xiuyuan and his legacy, gradually helping to soothe Ms. Heying's grief.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: These prizes... Did you make them yourself?

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: That's right. The Moonlit Fair is about community, so we thought practical items would be more meaningful.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: A Ranger instructor taught us how to make them. Even though he's no longer with us, his instructions and methods continue to guide us.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: These tools were a great help when we first joined the Rangers. We've now improved them to help even more people.

speaker: Thanh Khê
anh_en: Please take them, Mrs. Heying. I'm sure Xiuyuan would want you to have them.

speaker: NPC #1371
anh_en: And you are...?

speaker: Rover
anh_en: The third wish... Let's see what's written this time.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Ugh, this again... I'm so over this cheesy old play...

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: ...Hmph. I'm gonna tell Mahn if you keep doing this. Wait till he comes back, he'll give you a knuckle sandwich.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Pfft, you think telling Mahn's gonna help you? With him around, you'll never get the chance to be Flame Ranger!

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: At least I won't get beat up by you all the time!
Do any of you know Mahn?

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Hey. Where did this weird grown-up with a flying bunny come from...?

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Mahn's not here, I'm in charge! Wanna play with us? Okay, then you can be a monster!

speaker: NPC #1367
anh_en: Detected new name entry: "Bunny."

speaker: NPC #1367
anh_en: Processing speed increased to 150%. Processor temperature: 90℃, 91℃, 92℃...
We're not here to play games.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: There are way better ones... Come on, switch it up! What about "Rainbow Mirror"? I'll be Flame Ranger, you be his sidekick being controlled by the monsters!

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Ah!!! It's... it's gonna blow...!
Um... Xiangli Yao? You there?

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: I'm here, don't worry. I'm overriding Xiang-LEE's processor. One moment, please.

speaker: NPC #1367
anh_en: ...Recorded. New name entry, "Bunny."

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Phew. I almost wet my pants...

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: So... You're looking for Mahn, huh?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: He's not here right now, but if it's important, you can tell me, and I'll pass it on to him, word for word.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Pfft. Li's being a show-off again.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: We haven't seen Mahn for days. No way you can tell him anything.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Not true! We're doing one of his favorite plays tomorrow, he'll definitely show up!

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: No way... Why do I always have to be the one getting beat up? I don't wanna play the bad guy.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: We did a play yesterday and one before that. Hmph, I don't remember him showing up. Where was he?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Ugh! You suck, Momo!

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Hee hee hee!
Any ideas where I can find Mahn?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Well... We usually play together in the city or watch Hero Plays at the theater. Oh... and we have a secret base.

speaker: NPC #1367
anh_en: Detected. Keyword: Secret base.
Can you tell me where it is?
Do you think he'll be there?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Hmm... Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: We pinky-sweared last time, remember?! If I don't get to play as Flame Ranger, I'm not playing with you anymore.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Hmm... Maybe. Are you going to go look for him?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: But Mahn says it's top secret, and we can't tell anyone.
I'm here to help him become a great hero.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: What?! Really?!

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Um... He did mention before that there's this Flame power growing inside of him, and he's about to become a great hero just like Flame Ranger.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Well... I guess you don't look like a bad person, so...
Li leans close to your ear and whispers the location of the secret base to you.
Appreciate it.
Okay, got it.

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Err... If you do find him, please don't tell him I told you about the secret base.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: All right, all right. Let me think...

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: Oh, oh! And remember to tell him to come back and play with us soon.

With the second wish resolved, you hear two children, Li and Momo, arguing over something related to the Hero Plays. From their conversation, you discover that the third wisher, Mahn, is hiding in his secret base.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: Then let's do "Deep Sea Rescue." You can be Flame Ranger, and I'll be the sidekick.

speaker: Tiểu Mặc
anh_en: That good enough for you?

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: ...Oh, I see what you're up to, Momo... trying to trick me again... In "Deep Sea Rescue," the Flame Ranger falls into the villain's trap and gets beat up at the start!

speaker: NPC #1374
anh_en: So I'll still be the one getting whacked.
Take this! Flame Punch...!
Eek...! Get away from me!

speaker: Rover
anh_en: A child's voice. Over there!

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: ...Whoa, that was rad! How did you do that? You gotta teach me!

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Some of them are born with it, and some have to journey to distant mountains and secret caves to train all alone.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: And then—"After years of training, a Tacet Mark finally appears. Forte awaken." Hehe, that's my favorite part!

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: That's why I've been eating all my veggies and going to bed early lately. I want to be ready to spend the whole day at this secret base training.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: I try to practice every move I can think of from the plays, hoping my Forte will awaken soon. I've been so busy, I haven't even watched any Hero Plays lately.
So, has your Forte awakened yet?

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Um... Not really...

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: But I've come up with a new plan. You know how Flame Ranger gets stronger the more danger he's in? They call it a "Forte Boost"!

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: So I thought, why not find a scary monster and try to fight it?
So that Tacet Discord just now...

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Uh... That was an accident... I've no idea where it came from...

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Um... Thanks for saving me, {Male=mister;Female=miss}.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: If I'm gonna a great hero, I have to find an enemy that's even stronger than a TD.
That's too dangerous.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: But... but...

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Then, you tell me. What should I do to awaken my Forte?
Having a Forte is really so important to you?

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Absolutely, it's a must! Every hero in the plays is a Resonator with a Forte.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Becoming a hero means I can protect all my friends. None of us will ever need to be scared again.

speaker: NPC #1373
anh_en: Besides... being a hero is just the coolest. Every Hero Play, all my friends cheer like crazy for Flame Ranger. I don't plan on being the lame sidekick, no way.
You don't need a Forte to be a hero.
Why are you out here all alone?

speaker: NPC #1373

speaker: NPC #1346
anh_en: However, he wishes to become a hero by awakening his Forte...
